text.body:
||Bhelasaṃhitā|| sūtrasthānanam ||caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|| ................................ ................................ 1.4.1| pippalyo dīpyakaścaiva tathā mūṣikakarṇikāḥ| bilvasya pallavāḥ 1śvetā haridrā 1madhukaṃ tathā|| 1.4.2| ete kuṣṭhaṃ pratighnanti yuktāḥ pānapralepanaiḥ| gavāṃ pittaṃ śunaḥ pittamalāvūṃ 1kaṭukāṃ tathā|| 1.4.3| 1nimbaṃ nataṃ śarkarāṃ ca dadyāttadvatpralepanam| yātuṇḍamaṇḍalīdvīpāt mūlānyeḍagajasya ca(?)|| 1.4.4| surādanīṃ(?) sugandhāṃ ca dadyāttadvatpralepanam| 1suvarṇapuṣpīṃ 1kaṭukāṃ śyāmāṃ tejovatīṃ tathā|| 1.4.5| trivṛtsañjātakaṃ? caiva kuṣṭhe 1saṃśodhanaṃ viduḥ| āragvadhaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca sāśvagandhāṃ gavādanīm|| 1.4.6| śvetāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ caiva sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet| gavāṃ pittena taccūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ subhāvitam|| 1.4.7| 1yojyaṃ sarṣapatailena saindhavena ca 1yuktitaḥ| etadvai hṛtadoṣasya mitadadhyannabhojinaḥ|| 1.4.8| tanulepanamuddiṣṭaṃ kṛmikuṣṭhavināśanam| 1gavedhukamakuṣṭhau ca khadirakvāthapācitau|| 1.4.9| tāvapyubhau prayuñjīta kuṣṭhināṃ kuṣṭhaśāntaye| atha 1kaṇḍūghnavṛkṣāṇāṃ 1rasāḥ syuḥ kuṣṭhināṃ hitāḥ|| 1.4.10| pralepapariṣekeṣu khadirastu praśasyate| khadirodaka 1pāyī syātkhadirodakabhojanaḥ|| 1.4.11| bhūyiṣṭhamudakārthe ca kurvīta khadirodaram| sāravantau mahāvṛkṣau dhavarohita 1kāvubhau|| 1.4.12| śiṃśupā cāśvakarṇaśca 1khadiro bilvamāśritaḥ| kadalīmuṣkakau 1hiṃsrā bhadrodumbarikāphalam|| 1.4.13| etairapyuṣitaṃ kuṣṭhe 1gomūtraṃ pariṣecanam| sālāśvakarṇaniryāso 1niryāsaḥ kuliśasya ca|| 1.4.14| ete 1kuṣṭhanimittānāṃ vraṇānāṃ syuḥ prapīḍakāḥ| puṇḍarīkasya vakṣyāmi 1kriyāṃ rogavināśinīm|| 1.4.15| āvartāṃ śālmalīmūlaṃ malayūkāṃ 1sudhāṃ varīm| bhadrodumbarikāmūlaṃ phalānyāvalgujāni ca|| 1.4.16| rātrau 1yantreṇa niṣpīḍya danticitrakameva ca| pāṭhāṃ haridre ca tathā gavāṃ mūtreṇa yojayet|| 1.4.17| aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ tatsādhitaṃ supariṣkṛtam| pibetkālyaṃ samutthāya śvitrī śītodakaṃ pibet|| 1.4.18| 1sarvataḥ parirakṣettu 1sthāpayeccainamātape| bhaiṣajyapīḍitā doṣāstvacamasyānusaṃśritāḥ|| 1.4.19| maṇḍaleṣu tapasphoṭaṃ janayantyarkaraśmibhiḥ| sphoṭeṣvatha tu jāteṣu chāyāyāmupaveśayet|| 1.4.20| śītābhiradbhiḥ prakṣālya bhojayedrasabhojanam| 1saṃkṣubhyante 'tha vai toyaparipūrṇā ivāmbudāḥ|| 1.4.21| sūcyagreṇātha tīkṣṇena vyathayetkaṇṭakena vā| candanasya ca yatsāraṃ badarāt khadirasya ca|| 1.4.22| etaiḥ pānīyapiṣṭaistu sarpiḥkṣaudrasamanvitaiḥ| patreṣu puṣkariṇyāstu saṃviṣṭasyātha 1dehinaḥ|| 1.4.23| tatastvālepayetsphoṭān śītodakapariplutān| kṣīriṇāṃ cāpi vṛkṣāṇāṃ 1tvacaśaṃkṣodayed bhiṣak|| 1.4.24| taiḥ kaṣāyeiśca kalkaiśca siñcayellepayecca tam| kharjūrasya ca bījāni śaṅkhanābhiḥ ca dāpayet|| 1.4.25| 1añjanaṃ tagaraṃ patraṃ gairikaṃ nīlamutpalam| eṣāṃ sūkṣmeṇa cūrṇena sravantamavacūrṇayet|| 1.4.26| śakṛddrākṣākṣaudrayukto dātavyaḥ paripoṭane| āhārotsādanābhyaṅgaṃ pūrveṇa vidhinā bhiṣak|| 1.4.27| kārayetkuṣṭhināmevaṃ tataḥ sampadyate sukhī| na ca vyādhimupekṣeta śarīraṃ patitaṃ budhaḥ| tvareta śamane tasya pradīptasyeva veśmanaḥ|| 1.4.28| yathā hyekāntato vṛkṣo vardhate sukhataśśanaiḥ| tathā śarīramāsādya rogo 1vardhata eva tu|| 1.4.29| 1tasmādrakṣanmahāvegādakṣīṇasyaiva dehinaḥ| prāgevopacayādrogānhanyādvaidyo vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 1.4.30| tryahāttryahāccāvapīḍaḥ pakṣānmāsādvamettathā| 1recayedayane pūrṇe sirāmokṣo vidhīyate|| 1.4.31| 1śyāmākāśca makuṣṭhāni caṇakāḥ kuṣṭhināṃ hitāḥ| evaṃ hi vartamānānāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ praśamameti vai|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātyāśitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.5.1| athāśitena pītena khāditena ca yuktitaḥ| balamāpyāyate jantoḥ sadyo vahnirivendhanaiḥ|| 1.5.2| tenaivātyādṛteneha bhojanena śarīrajāḥ| vyādhayaśaṃpravardhante kāyāgnāvapi dūṣite|| 1.5.3| dvividhaṃ tu bhiṣagvidyādāhārasyaiva lāghavam| 1dvividhaṃ gauravaṃ 1bhukte procyamānaṃ nibodhata|| 1.5.4| mātrālaghuśyādāhāraḥ kaściddravyalaghuḥ smṛtaḥ| mātrāgurustathaiva syāddravyataśca tathā guruḥ|| 1.5.5| purāṇaśālayo mudgāḥ śaśatittirilāvukāḥ| 1evaṃprakāraṃ yaccānyat taddravyaṃ laghu 1saṃsmṛtam|| 1.5.6| 1grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ dadhi piṣṭaṃ 1tilāhvayam| evaṃprakāraṃ yaccānyattaddravyaṃ gurviti smṛtam|| 1.5.7| tatra yo mātrayā bhuṅkte dravyaṃ gurvapi mānavaḥ| āhāraṃ tasya paśyanti laghumeva 1cikitsakāḥ|| 1.5.8| 1śālyādīnyapi yo 'tyarthamaśnāti sulaghūnyapi| āhāraśa tathārūpo vyaktaṃ sampadyate guruḥ|| 1.5.9| dravyasya laghuno yuktyā sauhityaṃ yo 'dhigacchati| ekāntapathyaṃ taṃ vidyādāhāraṃ kuśalo laghum|| 1.5.10| 1yadi yuktyāpi sauhityaṃ dravyasyālaghuno vrajet| tathāvidhamihāhāraṃ gurumeva bravīmyaham|| 1.5.11| 1tasmāttribhāgasasauhityamardhasauhityameva vā| āhāraṃ laghumanvicchet 1gurūṇāṃ sevitaṃ sadā|| 1.5.12| 1laghu vāpi samāsādya dravyaṃ yo hyatisevate| tallaghvapyatisaṃyuktaṃ koṣṭhe sampadyate 1guru|| 1.5.13| gurulāghavavidvaidyo narāṇāṃ vardhayatyasūn| tasmādevaṃ vijānīyāddravyāṇāṃ gurulāghavam|| 1.5.14| evameva ca bhojyena pathyenāpyāyate naraḥ| hīyate cāpyapathyena praduṣṭairmārutādibhiḥ|| 1.5.15| 1svasthasyānnena vardhante dhātavaḥ śoṇitādayaḥ| vyādhitasyāpi doṣāya bhojyaṃ pariṇamatyatha|| 1.5.16| yathā hyakālavṛṣṭyā ca bhūmau bījaṃ vipadyate| vardhate kālavṛṣṭyā ca dehino 'pi tathā rasaiḥ|| 1.5.17| yaśca nityamudāraḥ 1syātsukhaniścalamānasaḥ| 1laghupānarataḥ sātmye 'pi yathāgasi dūragaḥ|| 1.5.18| snāto 'nuliptaḥ sragvī syāddhautadantaśvalaṃkṛtaḥ| 1dharmaśatyamahiṃsā ca prāyo 1hyannaṃ samāśritam|| 1.5.19| vamayecchaleṣmarogāṃśca1 paittikāṃśca virecayet| nirūhayedvātarogān raktajāṃścāvasecayet|| 1.5.20| 1raktaśālīn samudgān vā ṣaṣṭikānathavā punaḥ| susvinnānmātrayāśnīyāt ghṛtasaindhavasaṃyutān|| 1.5.21| īṣatpippalikaṃ yūṣamīṣacca madhunānvitam| īṣatsalavaṇaṃ cāpi payaścārdhakṛtaṃ pibet|| 1.5.22| viṣkirānpratudāṃścājān 1jāṅgalāṃśca mṛgadvijān| yaccānyatkaṭukaṃ pāke bhojyaṃ tannityamācaret|| 1.5.23| pādābhyāṃ na caretkṛṣṭe viṣame kaṇṭakeṣu ca| gahanaṃ paradārāṃśca nadīḥ pūrṇāśca na vrajet|| 1.5.24| kalahaṃ 1cāpi kopaṃ ca rātricaryāṃ vivarjayet| gajasya na syādāsannaḥ1 toyārdrasya ca vājinaḥ|| 1.5.25| janavādāṃśca śauṇḍāṃśca dviṣataścāpi mānavān| 1mlecchānnikṛtibuddhīṃśca na seveta kadācana|| 1.5.26| sarvān 1sarīsṛpāṃścaiva kṣudrapādāṃśca na spṛśet| mahiṣān gavayān khaḍgān vyāghrān siṃhāṃśca varjayet|| 1.5.27| nārohetpādapān veśma 1na dhāvedvarṣadurjale| na gavāṃ pratilomaṃ ca na madhye 1nāgrato vrajet|| 1.5.28| 1sadyaḥ pravṛṣṭau nāroheddhimavantaṃ ca parvatam| ghṛtamuṣṇāmbu ca bhajedetadārogyamuttamam|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|| atha na vegāndhāraṇīyaṃ 1vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.6.1| na vegāndhārayeddhīraḥ prāptānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ| na vātasya na pittasya na śuklasya kaphasya ca|| 1.6.2| udgāracchardijṛmbhāṇāṃ tathā ca kṣavathorapi| na bāṣpasya na nidrādeḥ prāptaṃ vegaṃ vidhārayet|| 1.6.3| rogasañjanakā hyete hiṃsyurāyurvidhāritāḥ| etāneva prakuryuśca tathā 'prāptāśamīritāḥ|| 1.6.4| vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇādanilādayaḥ| kupyanti retasaścāpi śarkarā sāśmarī tathā|| 1.6.5| tvagdoṣo vā jvaro vā syāt gātre 1śophādi vā punaḥ| chardipittakaphānāṃ tu dhāraṇena samīraṇāt|| 1.6.6| jṛmbhādidhāraṇādāndhyaṃ timiraṃ bāṣpadhāraṇāt| 1kṣavathūdgāranidrādeḥ dhāraṇātsyācchirorujā|| 1.6.7| tasmānmūtrapurīṣaṃ vai visṛjetkālyamutthitaḥ| uktā hyadhāraṇīyāstu 1dhāraṇīyānnibodhata|| 1.6.8| lobhamohabhiyāṃ tṛṣṇācintayormadamānayoḥ| śauryasya ca tathā vidvān prāptaṃ vegaṃ vidhārayet|| 1.6.9| etaddhārayato hyasya balamāyuśca vardhate| udaṅmukhaśśucau deśe 1prāṅmukhaścā 'vakuṇṭhitaḥ|| 1.6.10| āvaśyakamupāsīta kṛte cādbhirupaspṛśet| kṛtaśaucastato janturbhakṣayeddantadhāvanam|| 1.6.11| dhavaṃ palāśaw nyagrodhaw naktamālamathāpi vā|| śirīṣaṃ karavīraṃ ca jātivṛkṣamathārjunam|| 1.6.12| eteṣāṃ dantadhavanaṃ śreṣṭhamāha punarvasuḥ| āpāṭya vidalīkṛtya dantamāṃsamabādhayan|| 1.6.13| tadasya śodhayedvaktraṃ pittasya ca kaphasya ca| 1śamanaṃ vātaraktādeḥ kurute dantadhāvanam|| 1.6.14| mustakalkaṃ satriphalaṃ madhu tailaṃ sukhodakam| pratyekaṃ kabalagrāhaṃ dhārayedanupūrvaśaḥ|| 1.6.15| vātapittakaphā duṣṭāḥ śāmyanti kabalagrahāt| 1mādhūkaṃ copadehaghnaṃ svararaktaprasādanam|| 1.6.16| tailaṃ dantyaṃ surabhikṛttadabhiṣyandanāśanam| kṣataṃ 1saṃrohayedvaktraṃ 1śīryamāṇaṃ niyacchati|| 1.6.17| indriyāṇāṃ 1mato 'bhyaṅgo gurudoṣavimokṣaṇaḥ| tvagdoṣaśamano balyo vātaraktaprasādanaḥ|| 1.6.18| 1grāmyadharmātigatyā ca rathāśvagajapātanāt| daṇḍamuṣṭihatānāṃ ca rujāśramavināśanaḥ|| 1.6.19| tvacaḥ prasādano+1abhyaṅgaḥ śāmyatyutsādanātklamaḥ1| praharṣaṃ kurute sthairyaṃ malaghnaṃ cāvasecanam|| 1.6.20| vilepanaṃ hlādayati kaṇḍūṃ hanti prasādanam| śiśiraṃ 1hyañjanaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ timiraṃ ca praṇaśyati|| 1.6.21| tanūruhendriyabalaṃ nasyatailādupāgatāt| svararaktaprasādaśca naśyanti palitāni ca|| 1.6.22| svaktaḥ sūtsāditaścaiva praghṛṣṭaśca yathābalam| yathartuvāriṇā snātastvanuliptastataḥ param|| 1.6.23| prasādhitottamāṅgaśca tato nasyaṃ pradāpayet| tataśaṃśuddhadoṣasya dhūmamasya prakalpayet|| 1.6.24| kuṭannaṭailāhrīberaṃ dhyāmakāgarucandanam| kālānusāryāṃ naladaṃ pṛthvīkāmatha guggulam|| 1.6.25| tālīsaṃ padmakaṃ mustaṃ priyaṃguṃ sahareṇukām| haridrāṃ ca sugandhāṃ ca saralāṃ devadāru ca|| 1.6.26| śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaṃ corakaṃ ceti saṃharet| vaktraṃ ca sarpiṣāktaṃ syāddhūmametaṃ tataḥ pibet|| 1.6.27| aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇā vāpyathavā dvādaśāṃgulā| ṣaḍaṃgulapramāṇā vā dhūmavartiḥ praśasyate|| 1.6.28| sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ gajadantasya vā punaḥ| vṛkṣasāramayaṃ vāpi dhūmanetraṃ praśasyate|| 1.6.29| 1caturvā pañcakṛtvo vā dhūmaṃ srotasyavācaret| vātānulomanaṃ kuryācchleṣmāṇaṃ cāpakarṣati| balaṃ dadāti dṛṣṭeśca samyagdhūmo niṣevitaḥ|| 1.6.30| aṣṭau dhūmasya kālāḥ 1syuryeṣāmante praśasyate| utthitasyaiva śayanāddantaprakṣālane kṛte|| 1.6.31| jalakrīḍānivṛttasya tathā bhuktavato 'śanam| kṣutoccāravyavāyānte bhuktavāntavatastathā|| 1.6.32| guṇāṃścaikaikaśasteṣāṃ dhūmapānakṛtān śṛṇu| tatra śayyotthitasyaiva vakṣyāmyatha yathākramam|| 1.6.33| hantyutsannaṃ kaphaṃ jantoṣṣaḍindriyavibodhanaḥ| pratibuddhasya ceddhūmo mārutasyānulomanaḥ|| 1.6.34| dantaprakṣālanādūrdhvaṃ rogānsamyagvyapohati| cyutaśleṣmāpanayanaḥ sugandhiviśadāsyakṛt|| 1.6.35| dantamāṃsakṣayakṛtavyādhayo vadaneṣu ye| doṣāḥ kāsaprabhṛtayastāṃśca dhūmo vyapohati|| 1.6.36| śirogatā yāśca rujāḥ salilakrīḍanodbhavāḥ| karṇaśūlaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ cāśu dhūmo vyapohati|| 1.6.37| vātapittakaphān dhūmaḥ śamayedbhojanodgatān1| śiroviśuddhiṃ kurute bhuktaṃ ca sthāpayatyapi|| 1.6.38| dhamanipratipannastu vāyuḥ kṣavathuneritaḥ| vyāpnoti sarvasrotāṃsi sa dhūmenānulomyate|| 1.6.39| varcaḥkarmoddhato vāyurgalamūrdhaśirogataḥ| prāṇānādhmāpayati vā sa dhūmenānulomyate|| 1.6.40| śuklasrotogato vāyurūrdhvameva prapadyate| sa ghorān 1hi sṛjedrogāṃstaṃ1 dhūmenānulomayet|| 1.6.41| rogādhipataye chardyā sthānebhyo 'bhisamīritāḥ| anārogyāya kalpante teṣāṃ dhūmaḥ praśasyate|| 1.6.42| hṛteṣu doṣeṣvanilaḥ śūnyasthānāni saṃcaran| 1sammūrcchati śiro gatvā taṃ dhūmenānulomayet|| 1.6.43| pūrvaṃ pītodako bhuktvā labhate kṛśatāṃ naraḥ| madhye bhaktasya pibato bhojanaṃ nāpakṛṣyate|| 1.6.44| bhuktavānatha pānīyaṃ paścādanupibecca yaḥ| tadāpyānugataṃ bhuktaṃ samatvāyopapadyate|| 1.6.45| agnau pratāpayetpāṇī syātāṃ yāvattu nirjalau| tataḥ padaśataṃ gacchedbhaktaṃ hyevaṃ prayātyadhaḥ|| 1.6.46| na rātrau dadhi bhuñjīta nāghṛtaṃ nāpyamākṣikam| kuṣṭhau patepi vāṃchaṃ kiṃ kaṇṭharogācca buddhimān(?)|| 1.6.47| 1toyakṣiptaṃ spṛśennānnaṃ na ca paryuṣitāśanaḥ| na cājīrṇāśano janturjighāṃsurvyādhisaṃbhavam|| 1.6.48| 1sopānatkastathā daṇḍī chatreṇa vyajanena ca| 1ābādhān varjayetsarvānvicaredāpariśramāt|| 1.6.49| tapasvinaḥ pitṛṛndevānbrāhmaṇāṃśca samāhitaḥ| arcayanvidhivannityaṃ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ|| 1.6.50| vāto hi śūlaṃ vihataḥ karoti mūtrapradoṣaṃ janayecca mūtram| 1kāsaḥ pratiśyāyamatho kṣayaṃ ca śvāsaṃ ca kuryādvihate tu vege|| 1.6.51| purīṣamānāhamatīva kuryād reto 'varodhaḥ kurute 'tha ṣāṇḍyam| tasmāddhi vegaṃ na vidhārayeta naro ya icchediha dīrghamāyuḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāta indriyopakramaṇīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.7.1| indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi parijīryanti jīryataḥ| tasmātsarvatra vayasi yathākālaṃ striyaṃ vrajet|| 1.7.2| na tvanāpyāyitabalaḥ samāgacchettu yoṣitaḥ| nāyoniṣu prayuñjīta tiryagyonīśca varjayet|| 1.7.3| na prāptaṃ dhārayedvegaṃ 1gatvā śītodakaṃ spṛśet| na tu śrānto na 1vā bhukto na kliṣṭo 'pyāvilo na ca|| 1.7.4| kṛśo nātyaśito vāpi dīno vā maithunaṃ vrajet| mitavāk satataṃ yaḥ syātsnigdhānnāśī1 yuvā++ācaret|| 1.7.5| 1subahusnigdharetāśca yathartuśayanāśanaḥ| jīrṇāmāsannasatvāṃ ca vyādhitāṃ malināṃ kṛśām|| 1.7.6| vyaṅginīṃ 1parakāmāṃ ca pūtikoṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet| balamārogyamāyuśca vapustejaśca dehinām|| 1.7.7| hīyate hīdṛśīṃ gatvā prāpyākālajarāmiva1| ṛtāvṛtau yathākālaṃ maithunaṃ nā samācaret|| 1.7.8| varṣāsu navarātrāttu daśarātrāccharadyapi| pañcāhāddhemasamaye saptāhācchiśire tathā|| 1.7.9| pakṣādvasante grīṣme tu māsi māsi samācaret| nidāghe paścime māse maithunaṃ caiva varjayet|| 1.7.10| athavā yauvanotsāhabalasnehasamanvitaḥ1| śiśirāmbukṛtasnāno hṛdyasraganulepanaḥ|| 1.7.11| nātivyāyāmanirataḥ kṣīramāṃsaghṛtāśanaḥ| hṛdyamālyāmbaradharā hṛdyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ|| 1.7.12| hṛdyayauvanasaṃpannāḥ priyāḥ priyakathānugāḥ| hṛṣṭāḥ sarvatra kāle a śaktyardhena vrajetstriyaḥ|| 1.7.13| caturdaśīṃ pañcadaśīmaṣṭamīṃ ca vivarjayet| pibetkṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ nityamāyuṣyakaraṇaṃ hitam|| 1.7.14| balavarṇakaraṃ hyetadārogyakaraṇaṃ tathā| saṃhārayedromanakhaṃ trirmāsasya ca mānavaḥ|| 1.7.15| oṣadhīśca maṇīṃścaiva maṅgalyān dhārayetsadā| mantrānāvartayeccāpi brahmaproktaṃ sanātanam|| 1.7.16| sa me mādyāpagāddehādvāyuḥ prāṇāśca ye sadā| indro me balamādadyād śivaṃ cāpo diśantu naḥ|| 1.7.17| ityevaṃ mantramārṣaṃ vai bhuktvā gatvāthavā striyaḥ| saṃjapanvai spṛśan vāri tathā 'syāyurna hīyate|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto mātrāśitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.8.1| mātrāśī syādvipakvāśī daṇḍapāṇirmitādhvagaḥ| yathartubhojanaṃ kṛtvā janturdhūmamimaṃ pibet|| 1.8.2| praśasyate|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ iti bhele daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| 1athātaśamaśayanaparighanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.11.1| āhāraṃ praghasaṃ nYṇāmupayuktaṃ caturvidham| pacyamānaṃ dvidhā kāye koṣṭhe 1rasamalākhyayā|| 1.11.2| svedamūtraśakṛdrūpairniṣkrāmati1 malaḥ punaḥ| annasya pākatastejo raso nirvartyate nṛṇām|| 1.11.3| rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedastato 'sthi ca| asthno majjā tataḥ śuklaṃ śuklād garbhasya saṃbhavaḥ|| 1.11.4| evaṃ pūrvātparaṃ yāti 1dhātuṃ dhāturyathākramam| mātrāpathyaṃ yadā bhuktaṃ 1rasarūpaṃ gataṃ punaḥ|| 1.11.5| kuryānna rogān dīptāgneḥ rasavyāpattisambhavān| śoṇitādyātmatāṃ gacchet pariṇāmavaśāṃ tadā|| 1.11.6| yasmin vyāpadyate dhātau tasmin vyādhīn karotyatha| viṣūcikāṃ sālasakāṃ pittadāhaṃ vilambikām|| 1.11.7| anyedyuṣkaṃ satatakaṃ tṛtīyakacaturthakam| pittaṃ lohitapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi pralepakam|| 1.11.8| vipāṭikāṃśca tān vyādhīn rasavyāpattijān viduḥ| 1kacchūṃ carmadalaṃ pāmāṃ carmakīlaṃ vicarcikām|| 1.11.9| 1vyaṅgavīsarpakuṣṭhāni raktavyāpattijānviduḥ| māṃsakīlārbudaṃ gaṇḍamajakāṃ jātulāni(?) ca|| 1.11.10| 1pūtimāṃsālajīścaiva māṃsavyāpattijān viduḥ| daurgandhyaṃ svedanaṃ sthaulyaṃ pipāsāṃ bahunidratām|| 1.11.11| pramehān viṃśatiṃ cāpi medovyāpattijānviduḥ| dantarogo nakhaśmaśrukeśaromābhipātanam|| 1.11.12| ativṛddhistathā vāsthnāmasthivyāpattijān viduḥ| vidāhaṃ ca madaṃ caiva sonmādaṃ cāpatānakam|| 1.11.13| tamodarśanamūrchāyau majjāvyāpattijān viduḥ| retaḥ kṣārāgnimañjiṣṭhānīlahāridrakaṃ pṛthak|| 1.11.14| mehane bhasmavarṇaṃ ca śuklavyāpattijānviduḥ| narasya strīsvaratvaṃ vā strī vāpi puruṣasvarā|| 1.11.15| āmagarbhacyutirvāpi garbhavyāpattijānviduḥ| ityete āmajā nYṇāṃ viruddhādhyaśanātmakāḥ| viruddhāśanavarjī syādetadārogyamuttamam|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ iti bhele ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ ātreyakhaṇḍakāpyīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.12.1| 1ātreyaḥ khaṇḍakāpyaśca maitreyo 'nye ca tadvidhāḥ| rasasaṃkhyākathāṃ cakrurvane caitrarathe dvijāḥ|| 1.12.2| tatra kaścidrasaikatvaṃ rasasāmānyato 'bravīt| sātmyāsātmyāttathā dvitvaṃ traividhyaṃ sthānato 'pare|| 1.12.3| 1svādurasvāduramṛdurmṛduśceti1 catuṣṭayam| mahābhūtavibhāgena pañcetyāhustathāpare|| 1.12.4| tadetadevaṃ jānīyādyathoktādeva kāraṇāt| ṣaṭtvaṃ 1saptatvamathavā 1brūyustadrucibhedataḥ|| 1.12.5| madhuro lavaṇāmlau ca kaṣāyakaṭutiktakāḥ| kṣāraśca tān rasān sapta 1nātirekaṃ samācaret|| 1.12.6| rasātisevanājjantuśadyo mṛtyumavāpnuyāt| bhaveyurvyādhayaścāsya 1rasavyāsaṅgasaṃbhavāḥ|| 1.12.7| vṛttarohitarājībhiḥ vṛttākṣaśśakalī tathā| matsyaścilicimo nāma kūle carati vāriṇaḥ|| 1.12.8| taṃ matsyaṃ varjayedekaṃ dugdhenānyāṃstu bhakṣayet| payasā bhakṣyamāṇastu 1nararaktaṃ pradūṣayan|| 1.12.9| raktavyāpattijānvyādhīn mṛtyuṃ cāpi 1sa yacchati| śvāvidvarāhaṃ caikatra payasā parivarjayet|| 1.12.10| vanyamūlaphalāhārastadvidhena1 viruddhyate| aśnīyātpayasā 1yastu sadyo mṛtyumavāpnuyāt|| 1.12.11| bhaveyurvyādhayaścāsya 1śaṅkharogagalagrahāḥ| madhunā gorasenāpi likucaṃ 1na ca bhakṣayet|| 1.12.12| bādhiryaṃ vā 'pyathāndhyaṃ vā mṛtyuṃ vā bhakṣayan vrajet| kapotān sarṣapairbhṛṣṭān payasā na tu bhakṣayet|| 1.12.13| majjāvyāpattijān vyādhīnprāpnuyāddhi tathā param| payasā sarpadaṣṭaśan 1khādyaiśiddhyati 1tādṛśaiḥ|| 1.12.14| krimijā vyādhayaścāsya dṛśyante yadi jīvati| iha yā strī pumāṃścaiva hitajīrṇamitāśanau|| 1.12.15| anudāvartinau caiva syātāṃ garbhastayoḥ khalu| balavān varṇavāṃścaiva cakṣuṣmāṃśca bhavatyatha|| 1.12.16| viparyaye vartamānau1 viparītamiharcchataḥ| ajīrṇe tvaśanaṃ yasya jīrṇe cānaśanaṃ bhavet|| 1.12.17| sa tathobhayathā rogān dāruṇān prāpyānnaraḥ| tasmājjīrṇe ca pathyāśca mātrāvanto 'virodhinaḥ| sarva 1eva rasā bhojyāḥ 1yuktyā saṃvṛtadhātubhiḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto janapadavibhaktīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.13.1| kasmin janapade rogāḥ ke bhavantyadhikā iti| gurdālubhekinā pṛṣṭo vyācacakṣe punarvasuḥ|| 1.13.2| matsyānnabhojino nityaṃ prācyāḥ syuḥ kaphapittanaḥ| ślīpadaṃ galagaṇḍaṃ ca prāyaśasteṣu dṛśyate|| 1.13.3| nadītoyagatān matsyān bhakṣayanti samudrajān| prāyaśaḥ kuṣṭhikāstena manuṣyā dakṣiṇādiśi|| 1.13.4| masūrayavagodhūmatilakoddālasevinaḥ| bhūyiṣṭhamarśasāstena kāmbhojādantajāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 1.13.5| māṃsakāmāḥ surākāmāḥ strīkāmāśāhasapriyāḥ| prīcyāstena bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dṛśyante rājayakṣmiṇaḥ|| 1.13.6| tīkṣṇoṣṇāni hi bāhlīkāḥ prāyeṇānnāni bhuñjate| abhiṣyandīni māṃsāni pānakānyaudakāni ca|| 1.13.7| prakṛtyā cāpyabhiṣyaṇṇāḥ1 pārvatopatyakāśadā| tena bāhlīkadeśeṣu prāyo vyādhirbalāsakaḥ|| 1.13.8| 1meghe 'varṣati varṣāsu hemante yatra varṣati| ṛtuvyāpattisamaye janamāraḥ pravartate|| 1.13.9| tatropavāsī dhṛtimān rato viprābhivādane| mantrauṣadharataścāpi janamārāt pramucyate|| 1.13.10| sūryopatāpātsahasā varṣānte pittamīryate| śaradi prāyaśastena jvaro bhavati dehinām|| 1.13.11| gavāṃ ca 1cāraṇākhyaśca catuṣpācchvāpadeṣu ca| indrajālaśca matsyeṣu śakunānāṃ pramīlakaḥ|| 1.13.12| citrakaśarvadhānyeṣu davo mūlaphaleṣu ca| hastināṃ 1pākalaścaiva jvara ityabhidhīyate|| 1.13.13| utkarṇakastathāśveṣu tejaśarvāmayeṣu ca| sarvatra vasati hyeṣa eṣa 1cāntaka ucyate|| 1.13.14| taṃ 1dhūmaketuṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṣipraṃ praśamayejjvaram| asātmyaṃ gandhamādāya vāto yatrātivījyate1|| 1.13.15| tatra martyeṣu sāmānyaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ pravartate| tathā batālikā nāma piṭakā cāsya jāyate|| 1.13.16| kakṣāyāmūrumūle ca pāṇipādataleṣu ca| kaṇṭhe vā śrotramāśritya vastau vā hṛdaye 'pi vā|| 1.13.17| tvaramāṇaścikitseta pravṛddhā mārayennaram| pittaśleṣmasamutthānā vātaśoṇitmūrcchitā|| 1.13.18| batāliketi tāmāhuryatnavāṃstatra jīvati| ityetatsamyaguddiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ yadyacca coditam| ṛṣibhyaḥ paripṛcchadbhyaḥ praśnajātaṃ yathākramam|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ cikitsāprābhṛtīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.14.1| cikitsāprābhṛto vidvān 1vidyāt saṃśodhane vidhim| na ca dhāmārgavaṃ dadyātsnehasvedānupaskṛte|| 1.14.2| yo hi saṃśodhanaṃ 1pītvā sakaṣāyāṇi sevate| tasya tāni tadā jīvaṃ 1harantyanu hutāśanam|| 1.14.3| dāru śuṣkamivāsvinnaṃ nāmyamānaṃ yathā bhevet| tathā virecanaṃ hanyātsnehasvedānupaskṛte|| 1.14.4| snehasvedopapannaṃ tu charditaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ| virecanasya siddhyarthaṃ pūrvamāsthāpayed bhiṣak|| 1.14.5| ajīryadatha rūkṣaṃ hi virecanamathollikhet| oṣadhīrhīnavīryāśca mātrāhīnāśca varjayet|| 1.14.6| 1atimātraṃ hi bhaiṣajyaṃ jīvaṃ harati dehinām| tasmātkālaṃ balaṃ mātrāmṛtuṃ vidyādvirecane|| 1.14.7| yathā vṛkṣasya puṣpeṣu palāśeṣu phaleṣu ca| 1śīrṇeṣvanyāni rohanti tathā vyādhiranirhṛtaḥ|| 1.14.8| yathā mūle tarośchanne mlāyatyagraṃ na saṃśayaḥ| evaṃ virecite vyādhirupaśāmyati dehinām|| 1.14.9| 1udakaṃ codamanthaṃ ca matsyānmāṃsatilānapi| guru cānnaṃ na bhuñjīta 1snehasantarpaṇāni ca|| 1.14.10| virecanaṃ tu yaḥ pītvā dāruṇaṃ1 rūkṣite gude| dāruṇaṃ bhaktamaśnāti 1tamāmiṣarasena vai|| 1.14.11| tadyathā hyudakaṃ 1nimnaṃ sthalādadhyavarohati| snehitasya tathā doṣāḥ kukṣimāyānti sarvaśaḥ|| 1.14.12| snehanairvyādhitasthānādrasaiścābhyadhikīkṛtāḥ| svedairmṛdūkṛtāśantaḥ srotasā ca samāgatāḥ|| 1.14.13| mṛdusarvāṅgakoṣṭhasya bheṣajaiśśucibhistadā| doṣāśunirharā jantorbhavantīti viniścayaḥ|| 1.14.14| eṣa 1heturvirekeṣu chardaneṣveṣa eva tu| eṣa heturnirūheṣu śirasaśca virecane|| 1.14.15| bahusnigdho viriktaśca yo 1rasairnopapādyate| bheṣajairapyupastabdhaḥ so 'timātraṃ 1vipadyate|| 1.14.16| vakṣyāmi ca 1kriyāmanyāmajātavyādhināśinīm| madhu seveta varṣāsu sarpiḥ śaradi cācaret|| 1.14.17| sammiśraṃ gaṇḍakenaiva vāruṇīṃ śiśire pibet| mārdvīkaṃ tu vasante vai nidāghe kṣīramācaret|| 1.14.18| kalmāṣā vātalā rūkṣā 1guravo bhinnavarcasaḥ| 1śiraso 'ntastarpayantaḥ śleṣmaṇaśca viśoṣaṇāḥ|| 1.14.19| udāvartāñjayantyete snigdhatvādgauravādapi| raukṣyāttridhā sā jananāt śleṣmannākalāstathā(?)|| 1.14.20| evaṃ tu vartamānānāmāyurvṛddhimavāpnuyāt| nYṇāṃ 1samādhipūrṇānāmadīnamanasāṃ tathā|| ityāha bhgavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātastisraiṣaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.15.1| prāṇaiṣaṇā 1syātprathamā dvitīyā tu 1dhanaiṣaṇā| dharmaiṣaṇā tṛtīyā tu puruṣasya bhavatyatha|| 1.15.2| tatra prāṇaiṣaṇāṃ1 pūrvaṃ samāpadyeta mānavaḥ| dharmārthakāmaprāptirhi sadbhiḥ prāṇaiḥ prapadyate|| 1.15.3| dharmadīnāmavāptiśca puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ| tasmāccharīraṃ 1prayataḥ parirakṣeddhi śāstrataḥ|| 1.15.4| 1dhanaiṣaṇāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu samāpadyeta mānavaḥ| 1pāpīyo nāstyataḥ kiñcidyathā jīvannṛte dhanāt|| 1.15.5| dharmakāmau 1na saṃpīḍya tasmādvittamupārjayet| jvararogādikā yena nirasyedāpado budhaḥ|| 1.15.6| dharmaiṣaṇāṃ tṛtīyāṃ tu samāpadyeta mānavaḥ| 1avaśyamādhigantavyā dehabhede varā gatiḥ|| 1.15.7| 1prāṇādyanuparodhena tasmāddharmaṃ caredbudhaḥ| trivargānuparodhena tatprāptirhi nare hitā|| 1.15.8| ityetāśammatā loke vyākhyātāstisra 1eṣaṇāḥ| yathoktāstāḥ prayuñjānaḥ paratreha ca modate|| 1.15.9| 1upastambhāstu catvāro 1yadāhāraścaturvidhaḥ| śarīre ca balaṃ caiva malaṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate|| 1.15.10| śarīramātmano marma 1malamātmabalaṃ punaḥ| 1rogāstasyātivṛddhyāṃ ca vātapittakaphātmakāḥ|| 1.15.11| malaṃ tu rogo bhavati vaiṣamyaṃ dhātubhirgataiḥ| malāccāpyeti vaiṣamyaṃ tasmāttamabhinirharet|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| 1athāto vātakalākalīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.16.1| 1katamo 'bhyadhiko doṣo nyūnaścaiveti 1tatvataḥ| kṛṣṇātreyaṃ puraskṛtya kathāścakrurmaharṣayaḥ|| 1.16.2| 1vātaṃ tatrādhikaṃ kaścitprāhānyamupahanti1 yaḥ| yāvattiṣṭhati vāto hi dehī tāvattu jīvati|| 1.16.3| sa hi garbhāśaye śuklaṃ visraṃsayati yoṣitaḥ| vātaḥ striyā rajo hanti vandhyā bhavati tena sā|| 1.16.4| na striyaḥ puruṣā vāpi vandhyāśantīha 1janmanā| āśaye śītalo vāpi vātaśśuṣkendriyastathā|| 1.16.5| vātaḥ 1sadindriyo vāpi vāto hīnendriyastathā| ālokitaṃ nimiṣitaṃ yacca kiṃcidviceṣṭitam|| 1.16.6| aśītiścāmayā nYṇāṃ nāvātātsaṃbhavanti hi| vātāddhi kubjāḥ kuṇinaḥ khaṃjā gṛdhrasinastathā|| 1.16.7| hīnāṅgā hyadhikāṅgāśca bhavantyanye1 ca tadvidhā| sthitiḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ caiva saritāṃ caiva niḥsvanāḥ|| 1.16.8| pṛthivyāścalanaṃ caiva vātādeva pravartate| vātena dhūmo bhavati dhūmādabhraṃ prajāyate|| 1.16.9| abhrādvimucyte vāri bījānāṃ sambhavastataḥ| ulkānipātaḥ stanitaṃ 1vidhutārāgaṇasya ca|| 1.16.10| vidyutāṃ ca balaṃ caiva vātādeva pravartate| agnirjvalati vātena puṇyānāṃ haviṣāṃ patiḥ|| 1.16.11| sravanti cāpagāstena pṛthivīṃ 1plāvayanti ca| vāyustatrādhiko devaḥ prabhavaśarvadehinām|| 1.16.12| yonyāṃ retaḥ prasiktaṃ ca vāyunā yujyate guṇaiḥ| 1eṣa pittaṃ kaphaṃ caiva hanyādanyataraṃ tayoḥ|| 1.16.13| ādāya kupito vāyuḥ dehe vipratipadyate| evaṃ vyānamudānaṃ ca samānaṃ ca pracakṣate|| 1.16.14| 1dehe bahuviśeṣitvādapānaṃ1 prāṇameva ca| 1ūrdhvago 'trāpyudānaḥ syād vyānastiryagvivṛddhikṛt|| 1.16.15| prāṇo nyasyatyapānaṃ tu pravartayati dehinām| samāno dhāraṇaścaiva saṃgṛhṇāti sa dehinām|| 1.16.16| indriyāṇi manaścaiva bhūtātmānaṃ ca sammataḥ| viśeṣastvaparo vāyurapāna iti saṃjñitaḥ|| 1.16.17| śoṣaṇaścaraṇaścaiva tathā vicaraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ| vāyuḥ pañcasu 1bhūteṣu bhūtaṃ paramamucyate|| 1.16.18| tāni vāyunibaddhāni vāyuśarvatra sarvadā| 1mūtrendriyapurīṣāṇāṃ vāyorutsarga eva ca|| 1.16.19| pācanāccaiva bhuktasya karmāpānasya śiṣyate| prāṇaḥ prīṇāti bhūtāni prāṇo jīva iti smṛtaḥ|| 1.16.20| vyānāccharīraceṣṭā ca 1nimeṣonmeṣaṇāni ca| yaccānyadūrdhvagaṃ jantostadudānasya ceṣṭitam|| 1.16.21| 1kṣavathuṃ hikkitaṃ kāsamucchvāsaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ tathā| gudamādhmāpayatyeṣa dehaṃ yaśa ca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.16.22| eṣu pratiṣṭhito vāyurapāna iti saṃjñitaḥ| ityebhirīdṛśaiścānyairhetubhistattvadarśibhiḥ| bhūtebhyo 'bhyadhikaṃ vātaṃ lakṣayāma śarīriṇām1|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto daśaprāṇāyatanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.17.1| caturvidhamatho bhuktaṃ daśadhā prāṇamṛcchati| ūṣmasvedaśakṛnmūtraistathā vātādibhistribhiḥ|| 1.17.2| striyāḥ stanyena śuklena śoṇitena1 ca vāpyatha| ityebhirdaśabhiḥ prāṇaḥ 1sthirībhavati dehinām|| 1.17.3| 1īhate 'mṛtavadvṛttiṃ vātapittakaphaistribhiḥ| āhārasāmyayogāddhi vaiṣamye vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 1.17.4| iha dvau bhiṣajau vidyāt jñaścaivājñaśca dehinām| tatra jñaḥ sūtravānyaḥ syātsūtrārthena vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 1.17.5| pañcāśrayānkaṣāyāṃśca bhojanaṃ 1caturāśrayam| catuḥśreṣṭhāṃstathā snehānāmayāṃścāturāśrayān|| 1.17.6| cūrṇapradehānvividhān 1yavāgūścāṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ| dvādaśānnāni pathyāni prāyaścittadvayaṃ tathā|| 1.17.7| triṃśataṃ copanāhānāṃ sthāneṣvaṣṭāsu tattvataḥ| sūtrasthānaṃ cikitsā1 ca triṃśatriṃśadihocyate|| 1.17.8| aṣṭau nidānānyuktāni vimānāni tathaiva ca| 1śārīrāṇyaṣṭa gātrāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ yatra varṇitam|| 1.17.9| siddhayo dvādaśa proktāstathā kalpendriyāṇi ca| etadviṃśaśataṃ proktaṃ mūlinyo yatra ṣoḍaśa|| 1.17.10| ekonaviṃśatirjñeyāḥ phalinyaḥ kṣīriṇītrayam| āyurjñānamariṣṭibhyaḥ sādhyāsādhyacikitsitāḥ|| 1.17.11| 1rogajñānaṃ nidānebhyo deśakālau vimānataḥ| śārīrāddhātusaṃghātaṃ prakṛtiṃ dhātusātmyatām|| 1.17.12| anyadevaṃvidhaṃ yacca śāstre kiṃcidapi śrutam| bhiṣagyo vai1 vijānāti sajñaḥ ajñaṃ tu nibodhata|| 1.17.13| yo 'nnakāle yavāgūṃ tu sūpakāle tathā rasam| yūṣakāle 'tha māṃsaṃ tu śodhyeṣu stambhanāni ca|| 1.17.14| virecanīye vamanaṃ 1nirūhye cānuvāsanam| viparyayeṇa 1yo 'nyadvā kurute so 'jña ucyate|| 1.17.15| yogena vidyāmādadyāttasmāttattvadidṛkṣayā| yathā tamasi dīpaḥ syāttathā śāstraṃ prakāśakṛt|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto 'nnarakṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.18.1| gāndhārabhūmau rājarṣirnagnajitsvargamārgadaḥ| saṃgṛhya pādau papraccha cāndrabhāgaṃ punarvasum|| 1.18.2| na ca strībhyo na 1cāstrebhyo na bhṛtyebhyo 'sti me bhayam| anyatra viṣayogebhyaḥ so 'tra me śaraṇaṃ bhavān|| 1.18.3| evamuktastathā tasmai maharṣiḥ pārthivarṣaye| viṣayogeṣu vijñānaṃ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ|| 1.18.4| viṣeṇa saha saṃsṛṣṭamannapānaṃ caturvidham| yāni 1duṣṭāni rūpāṇi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu|| 1.18.5| 1pratikūlamivābhāti phenilaṃ viplutākṛti1| 1śuklaṃ bhavati yatkṣipraṃ nainaṃ śliṣyanti makṣikāḥ|| 1.18.6| dhūmaścāsya gataḥ 1śyāmo raktaḥ kṛṣṇo 'tha pītakaḥ| prādurbhavati tadvidyād duṣṭamannaṃ pracakṣaṇaḥ|| 1.18.7| nīlapītāsitā 1rājyo 1bhantīndrāyudhopamāḥ| madhye 1madyeṣu sarveṣu ye cānye pānasaṃśrayāḥ|| 1.18.8| anulepanadoṣe tu tvagasya bahulībhavet| sarvavyāpattimāpnoti klidyate 1māṃsameva ca|| 1.18.9| mālyaṃ tu śyāvapuṣpaṃ syānmlānaṃ kālaṃ ca dṛśyate| cūrṇayogāvakīrṇaṃ tu 1reṇunevāvṛtaṃ bhavet|| 1.18.10| romāṇi pariśīryante keśabhūmiśca dhūpyate| kūrcasparśaśca duḥkhaḥ syājjaṭilācāsya mūrdhajāḥ|| 1.18.11| vedanāṃ caiva kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute duṣṭamañjanam1| aśru sravati nātyarthamandhakāraṃ ca paśyati|| 1.18.12| dhūmadoṣe1 virekaḥ syādatyarthaṃ śirasaśca ruk| paridāhaśca bhedaśca gandhajñānamasādhu ca|| 1.18.13| na samyagvetti ca rasānaraṇīva ca mathyate| iti dhūmasya rūpāṇi sarvāṇyetāni lakṣayet|| 1.18.14| duṣṭe vāsasi liṅgāni sūcībhiriva tudyate| dahyate muñcati 1svedaṃ mūrchatyapyavalīyate|| 1.18.15| duṣṭe tvābharaṇe1 dāhaḥ svedaḥ kaṇḍūśca jāyate| kurute gātravaivarṇyaṃ svayaṃ cābhāti niṣprabhaḥ|| 1.18.16| duṣṭamāsanamāsthāyī vimūḍho vipatennaraḥ| sīdatyucchūnavṛṣaṇo na cotthātuṃ sahī bhavet|| 1.18.17| ūrū cāsya pravepete sadoṣāsanasevayā| duṣṭe tu śayane rūpaṃ 1suptiḥ kaṇḍūyate bhṛśam|| 1.18.18| svedaśca1 viṣamatyeti romakūpaiḥ samantataḥ| tudyamānaḥ punaḥ śayyāṃ 1manyate jantubhirvṛtām|| 1.18.19| sudine durdine cāpi durdine sudinaṃ tathā| syād bhūśca duṣṭaparyantā1 duṣṭacchatraniṣevaṇāt|| 1.18.20| kurute rūpavaivarṇyaṃ praduṣṭaśmaśruvardhakaḥ| śiśire muñcati svedaṃ grīṣme śītāturo bhavet|| 1.18.21| pravepate pravyathate gadgadā ca sarasvatī| syandanau ca vivarṇau ca paruṣau daśanacchadau|| 1.18.22| upānahau yadā duṣṭau tadā kaṇḍūḥ prajāyate| prasvidyate pādatalaṃ tathā cimacimāyate|| 1.18.23| atheha viṣapītasya viṣadagdhasya vā punaḥ| digdhaviddhasya vā rājan rūpāṇīmāni lakṣayet|| 1.18.24| gātrodveṣṭanamāpnoti vepate vyathate naraḥ| kampate cāpi kaṇṭho 'sya niḥsvanaṃ ṣṭhīvate muhuḥ|| 1.18.25| jihvā cāsya jaḍībhūtā 1śūlairiva ca tudyate| vyāhartuṃ ca na śaknoti 1śarma caiva na vindati|| 1.18.26| keśāntaṃ śīryate cāsya nakhāḥ śyāmībhavanti ca| aṅguṣṭhāṅgulayaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ hastapādatalaiḥ saha|| 1.18.27| śarīraṃ pāṇḍutāmeti viṣārtasyaiva dehinaḥ| so 'kṛtyakaratāmeti bhagno ratha ivāhave|| 1.18.28| tasmātkuryātkriyāṃ vaidyaḥ ṣoḍaśāgadakovidaḥ| hriyā yuktaḥ kulīnaśca dharmajño dīrghadarśanaḥ|| 1.18.29| arthāścāsya 1pratiṣṭheyā vidhivatsaṃbhṛtā gṛhe| cikitsiteṣu1 yā proktā viṣapraśamane hitā|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele 'ṣṭādaśodhyāyaḥ||
||ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto vidhiśoṇitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.19.1| vidhinā śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ 1sevamānasya vāruṇīm| praduṣyati vidāhena tato rogāya kalpate|| 1.19.2| sarvaṃ madyamacakṣuṣyamapauruṣyaṃ tathaiva ca| upahanti balaṃ nYṇāmanāyuṣyaṃ ca 1kīrtyate|| 1.19.3| yastu tadbhajate yuktyā na taṃ vyādhiḥ 1prasajjate| 1atipītaṃ ca tadviddhi1 tatrāhṛdyaṃ1 balāya 1na|| 1.19.4| na naktaṃ tu, pibedyuktyā pānaṃ tasmādvicakṣaṇaḥ| balavarṇakaraṃ hyetadārogyakaraṇaṃ param|| 1.19.5| snehapāne tathā mātrāvastikarmaṇi cāpyatha| kṣāre ca lavaṇe caiva na surā prātiṣidhyate|| 1.19.6| bṛṃhaṇaṃ nedṛśaṃ kijcidyathānnasahitā surā| tāṃ tu rūkṣāṃ viśeṣeṇa nātimātraṃ samācaret|| 1.19.7| vātena śleṣmaṇā caiva 1sampraduṣṭāṃ suśītalā| viśoṣya dīpayatyeṣā grahaṇīṃ vai śarīriṇām|| 1.19.8| yasya koṣṭhagato vāyurduḥkhamutpādayed1 bhṛśam| udāvartaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ vātagulmamathāpi ca|| 1.19.9| athavā sarvagātreṣu 1mārutaḥ pratyavasthitaḥ| yuktāṃ prasannāṃ pibataḥ sa kṣipramupaśāmyati|| 1.19.10| hantyāsavaḥ 1kaphaṃ pittaṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhinattyatha| madhu pittamariṣṭastu vātārtiṃ1 śamayatyatha|| 1.19.11| vastiḥ śuddhyati pānena śarkarā cāpi bhidyate| tejo balaṃ ca harṣaśca yuktyā pānena vardhate|| 1.19.12| 1kāmaṃ dīpayate svādurbṛṃhaṇo na vipadyate| tasmātpānaguṇān buddhvā yathāyogaṃ samācaret|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto 'rthedaśamūlīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.20.1| artha ityāha hṛdayaṃ tasmin dhamanayo daśa| ūrdhvaṃ catasro dve tiryak catasraścāpyadhaḥ kramāt|| 1.20.2| tābhyo mūlasirāstiryagbhidyante naikadhā sirāḥ| tasmāttadarthavijñānaṃ smṛtiyogaṃ ca mānasam|| 1.20.3| hṛdo raso 1niḥsarati tasmādeti1 ca sarvaśaḥ| 1sirābhirhṛdayaṃ 1vaiti tasmāttatprabhavāḥ sirāḥ|| 1.20.4| hṛdi prāṇāśca cakrasthāḥ vimāne karṇikā yathā| marmābhighātaṃ tenātra sahate hṛdaye na tu|| 1.20.5| puṇḍarīkasya saṃsthānaṃ kumbhikāyāḥ phalasya ca| etayoreva varṇaṃ ca vibharti hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām|| 1.20.6| yathā hi saṃvṛtaṃ padmaṃ rātrāvahani1 puṣyati| hṛttathā saṃvṛtaṃ svapne vivṛtaṃ jāgrataḥ smṛtam|| 1.20.7| āpo mahārasā vidyādannaṃ caiva mahauṣadham| mahāpralepanaṃ tatra tejaścaiva 1mahatparam|| 1.20.8| rasānāmudakaṃ yonirannaṃ vṛttiḥ parā smṛtā| 1viklinnamupasandhatte punaḥ kāyaṃ śarīriṇām|| 1.20.9| sūryāṃśaṃ dhūmamityāhuryato 'bhraprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ| abhrādvarṣaṃ tato 'nnāni, tasmāttejo mahatparam|| 1.20.10| svedaścāsraṃ ca mūtraṃ ca phenaṃ cāmyantaraṃ malam| avaśyāyahimāmbūni bāhmāni paricakṣate|| hṛdayo1 ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... | ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
iti bhele viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... virecyāṃścaiva mānavān| āsthāpyānanuvāsyāṃśca vātavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.1| virūkṣayedatisnigdhaṃ kṛmikoṣṭhinameva ca| rūkṣastambhyān pramehāṃśca kapharogāṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.2| vāmayecchaleṣmakāse ca 1pratiśyāye ca mānavān| hṛdroge caiva kuṣṭhe ca sarvaśleṣmāmayeṣu ca|| 1.21.3| vorecayeddhi kuṣṭhāni jvarānvisphoṭakāni ca| dāhaṃ vicarcikāṃ caiva vātavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.4| anvāsayetkaṭīpṛṣṭhapārśvarogān vicakṣaṇaḥ| udveṣṭanaṃ ca 1gulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.5| āsthāpayeddhi gulmāṃśca mūtrāghātodarāṇi ca| apasmārāṃśca kuṣṭhaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.6| svedayeta hanustambhamāyāmamapi cārditam| pārśvarogaṃ ca 1gulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.7| stambhayedraktapittaṃ ca visarpaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ| dāhaṃ visphoṭakāṃścaiva pittavyādhīṃśca sarvaśaḥ|| 1.21.8| iti pittakaphotthānvai1 vidyādāmāśayātmakān| pakvāśayasamutthāṃśca vātarogānvinirdiśet|| 1.21.9| vāmayedvamanīyāṃstu samīkṣyāmāśayānnarān1| virecayedvirecyāṃstu tathā pakvāśayāśrayān|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ svedādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 1.22.1| saṃkaraṃ prastaraṃ sekaṃ 1nāḍīṃ droṇiṃ jalāni ca| udakoṣṭhaṃ kuṭiṃ caiva svedamaṣṭavidhaṃ viduḥ|| 1.22.2| pāṣāṇabhasmasikatātuṣapāṃsubusāni ca| ajāvigopurīṣāṇi 1prāvārāṇi pravātikāḥ|| 1.22.3| payāṃsyamlāni 1dhānyāni girisādhāraṇānica| sarvāṇi madyamāṃsāni lavaṇāni tathaiva ca|| 1.22.4| vidhivadyojayetsvede1 1kāleyāgarurūṣitān| bhiṣag balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā balino 1durbalānapi|| 1.22.5| 1kuthakambalakauśeyaiḥ praveṇyajinakādibhiḥ| kiṭijairāvijairvastraiḥ pracchādya svedayennarān1|| 1.22.6| sparśasaukhyamavaivarṇyaṃ svedo 'ṅgeṣu ca mārdavam| śītābhinirgamaścaiva samyak svinnasya lakṣaṇam|| 1.22.7| pittaprakopo 1dāhaśca tṛṣṇā mūrchā vilāyanam| svedadveṣo 'ṅgarāgaścetyatisvinnasya jayati mārutam|| 1.22.10| śuṣkāṇyapi hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ| namayanti yathānyāyaṃ kiṃ punarjīvato narān|| 1.22.11| atisvinne viśeṣeṇa kārayecchītalāṃ kriyām| athavā śītalairvātha kṣīraiḥ siṃced ghṛtena vā|| 1.22.12| pipāsuṃ vā na śaktaṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ kukṣirogiṇīm| sarvāṃśca pittajān vyādhīn 1kaḥ svedaiḥ samupācaret|| 1.22.13| ye svedāḥ pūrvamuddiṣṭāstānapyekaikaśaḥ śṛṇu| bilvāgnimanthaśyonākaṃ kāśmarīṃ pāṭalāṃ tathā|| 1.22.14| yavān kulutthān kolāni sthālyāmāsicya sādhayet| yavapākāni vijñāya sukhoṣmāṇyavatārayet|| 1.22.15| tato 'bhyaktasya vidhivatsvedanīyasya dehinaḥ| gātraṃ gātraikadeśaṃ vā 1sukhoṣṇaiśchādayecchanaiḥ|| 1.22.16| tataḥ pracchādayed bhūyaḥ kauśeyājinakāmbalaiḥ1| saṅkarastveṣa vijñeyaḥ svedānāmagrya ucyate|| 1.22.17| etānyanyāni ca bhiṣak svedadravyāṇi saṃharet|| 1.22.18| prakīrya tāni śayane kalbalenāvaguṇṭhitam1| svabhyaktaṃ śāyayejjantuṃ1 svedaṃ prastaramādiśet|| 1.22.19| vasātailaghṛtakṣīramūtramastvamlakāñjikaiḥ| sukhauṣṇaiḥ 1secayetsvedyaṃ 1sekaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ|| 1.22.20| nāḍīṃ gajakarākārāṃ trihastāṃ tādṛśīṃ tathā| dhānyāmladravapūrṇāyāṃ dhānyāṃ sandhāya lepayet|| 1.22.21| tāṃ trihastāṃ samāhṛtya svabhyaktāṅgasya dehinaḥ| pracchannagātrasya tu tāṃ nāḍīmudghāṭayed bhiṣak|| 1.22.22| nāḍīsvedaḥ samākhyātaḥ yāvatprasvedanāditi| kaṇṭhāvagāhāmacchidrāṃ tāvadevāyatāṃ samām|| 1.22.23| droṇiṃ pāyasaniṣkvāthakṛsarakṣīrapūritām| kṛtvā tasyāṃ sukhoṣṇāyāṃ svabhyaktaṃ vātarogiṇam|| 1.22.24| jñātvāvagāhayettāvadyāvatsvedodgamo bhavet| taptaiḥ pātrayutairvāpi śuddhairvā salilairbhiṣak|| 1.22.25| svamyaktagātrasya tataḥ 1salilasvedamācaret| īdṛśaireva salilaiḥ kaṭāhe cārdhapūrite|| 1.22.26| praveśya svedayetsvedyamudakoṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| suliptāṃ saṃvṛtadvārāṃ 1yantritāṃ kārayetkuṭim|| 1.22.27| hrasvāgāramitāṃ hṛdyāṃ śilāstīrṇatalāṃ dṛḍhām| tāsyāścullyau ca kartavye adhastātpārśvasaṃvṛte|| 1.22.28| tatra sthālyau pratiṣṭhāpya sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet| sthālyau tapte kuṭiścāpi yadā sparśasaukhyamavāpnuyāt|| 1.22.31| kuṭisveda iti jñeyaḥ sadyo roganivartakaḥ| svedo 'gnihīnaḥ 1kṣuttṛṣṇābhayaṃ krodhastathāhavaḥ1|| 1.22.32| nivātamadhvasantāpau1 guruprāvaraṇaṃ tathā| svedyāstu ||caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ kāsanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 2.4.1| vātātpittātkaphāccaiva kṣatādvātha kṣayādapi| pañca 1kāsā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.4.2| yaśadā vātalo janturasātmyaṃ vai niṣevate| rūkṣamaśnāti pibati rūkṣaṃ 1hi bahu khādati|| 2.4.3| tasya vātaḥ prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ| ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya 1dhamanīratha kāsāya kalpate|| 2.4.4| uraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhastabhaśca1 jāyate| āṭopyate 'syodaraṃ ca 1śiraścāsyātimanthyate|| 2.4.5| uro 'bhighātātpārśve ca gṛhyete iva dehinaḥ| 1kaphaḥ prakāsamānasya sasaṃrambhaḥ pravartate| 2.4.6| pratataṃ kāsamānasya mūtraṃ 1vāto ruṇaddhi hi| ityebhirlakṣaṇairvidyādvātakāsaṃ śarīriṇām|| 2.4.7| yaśadā pittalo janturasātmyaṃ vai niṣevate| amlamaśnāni pibati khādatyāsvādayatyapi|| 2.4.8| tasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ| ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīstataḥ kāsāya kalpate|| 2.4.9| uro vidahyate cāsya tathaivāpyabhitapyate1| 1soṣmanāsaśca bhavati 1dahyete cākṣiṇī tataḥ|| 2.4.10| niṣṭhīvati sapittaṃ ca raktaṃ vā nā kadācana| mukhaṃ bhavati vā pītaṃ pittakāsena dehinaḥ|| 2.4.11| yaśadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| pibatyaśnāti madhuraṃ madhuraṃ 1vāpi khādati|| 2.4.12| avyāyāma 1rataścāpi divāsvapnaṃ ca sevate| tasya śleṣmā prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ|| 2.4.13| ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīstataḥ kāsāya kalpate| grathitaṃ śleṣmaṇā kāsaṃ niṣṭhīvati sapūtikam|| 2.4.14| duṣṭaśleṣmapratiśyāyaḥ śleṣmakāsena jāyate| sāhasaṃ karma yaḥ kṛtvā 1vikṣataṃ khedayatyuraḥ|| 2.4.15| niṣṭhīvati saraktaṃ ca kāse kṣatasamudbhave| strīṣu saktaśca yo jantustasya śuklaparikṣayāt|| 2.4.16| liṅgaṃ vātābhibhūtatvātsūcībhiriva tudyate| saraktaṃ kurute mūtraṃ tathā 1śuklaṃ ca lohitam|| 2.4.17| sarva ete samuddiṣṭāḥ kāsā lakṣaṇato mayā| tānavekṣya bhiṣag buddhyā tataḥ kuryāccikitsitam1|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele nidāne caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 2.5.1| pippalīṃ kākamācīṃ1 ca likucaṃ dadhisarpiṣā| vātāyuṃ1 payasā sārdhaṃ 1guḍena saha mūlakam|| 2.5.2| anyadevaṃvidhaṃ yacca viruddhaṃ tatsamaśnataḥ| chardiṃ pratighnataścāpi mithyāsaṃsargasevanāt|| 2.5.3| anullikhya vidagdhaṃ ca vidāhi ca samaśnataḥ| 1pathi cārādviriktasya1 śrāntasyodakasevanāt|| 2.5.4| matsyān payaśca 1nimbūṃśca tathaikadhyaṃ samaśnataḥ| jantośañjāyate kuṣṭhaṃ tadvidhānāṃ ca sevanāt|| 2.5.5| yaśadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate|| 2.5.6| sa vṛddho dūṣayatyasya māṃsaṃ tvagrudhiraṃ1 tathā| utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpyatha|| 2.5.7| tatra kuṣṭhāni jāyante dadru sidhmāni 1vai punaḥ| maṇḍalāni ca citrāṇi teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.5.8| maṇḍalāni ghanānīha piṭakābhāni sarvaśaḥ| sakaṇḍūni visarpīṇi dadrukuṣṭhāni nirdiśet|| 2.5.9| prasravanti yadā tāni 1doṣotsannāni dehinaḥ| tadāsya kīlaṃ koṣaṃ ca picchilaṃ saṃsravanti ca|| 2.5.10| 1saṃhatāni vipāṇḍūni 1paṅkiloṣṭhacitāni ca| 1tvagutthāni tu rūksāṇi maṇḍalāni tanūnyapi|| 2.5.11| sidhmakuṣṭhāni jānīyāttathā tāni bhavanti vai| picchilaṃ madhuvarṇaṃ ca 1yadā doṣāḥ sravanti ca|| 2.5.12| maṇḍalāni ca śuklāni ghanotsannāni sarvaśaḥ| vidyānmaṇḍalakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām|| 2.5.13| yadā tu tāni bhidyante tadā 1śvetaṃ sravanti hi| iti śleṣmasamutthāni trīṇi kuṣṭhāni nirdiśet|| 2.5.14| yaśadā vātalo janturvātalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| vātātapau sevate ca tasya 1vātaḥ pravardhate|| 2.5.15| sa vṛddho dūṣayatyasya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tathā| 1utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpyatha|| 2.5.16| kapālakuṣṭhaṃ tenāsya praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite| jantorvivṛddhavātasya tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.5.17| paruṣāṇyaruṇābhāni maṇḍalāni samāni ca| vidyātkapālakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām|| 2.5.18| yaśadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| vātātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ prakupyati|| 2.5.19| tad vṛddhaṃ dūṣayatyasya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tadā| utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpyatha|| 2.5.20| tataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite| pittasya parikope vā teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.5.21| pakvodumbaravarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu| vidyādaudumbarāṇyatra tānyasādhyāni dehinām|| 2.5.22| prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ kuṣṭhānyaudumbarāṇi ca| maṇḍalīkāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni bhavanti vai|| 2.5.23| maṇḍalāni ca yānīha puṇḍarīkanibhāni vai| puṇḍarīkāṇi sādhyāni tāni vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| 2.5.24| prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ puṇḍarīkāṇi yāni vai| ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni vinirdiśet|| 2.5.25| nīlotpalasavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha rūpataḥ| ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tānyasādhyāni nirdiśet|| 2.5.26| prāpnuvanti yadā bhedamṛśyajihvānyaśeṣataḥ| kākaṇānīti matimāṃstadā tāni vinirdiśet|| 2.5.27| 1kākaṇantikavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu| kākaṇānīti tānyāhuḥ pratyākhyeyāni dehinām|| 2.5.28| iti kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vai vyākhyātamanupūrvaśaḥ| tanniśamyeha matimān hitajīrṇāśano bhavet|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele nidāne pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 2.6.1| prakṛtiprabhavaścaiva narasya svakṛtastathā| jñeyaḥ prameho dvividhastasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.6.2| ślakṣṇāṅgā mṛdavaḥ snigdhā bhṛśaṃ śleṣmalamedurāḥ| jātapramehā nardanti matsyamāṃsocitā narāḥ|| 2.6.3| mātāpitṛbhyāmīdṛgbhyāṃ janito yastu mānavaḥ| medaḥśithilanāttasya prakṛtyā sa tu mehati|| 2.6.4| anūpajānāṃ susnigdhairvividhaiścāpi vārijaiḥ| gavyājaurabhramāṃsaiśca sadyo dadhnā ghṛtena vā|| 2.6.5| guḍaprakāraiḥ payasā 1palalenaudakaiḥ khagaiḥ| avyāyāmāddivāsvapnātsukhaśayyāsanāttathā|| 2.6.6| ityebhirīdṛśaiścānyairmedaḥ1 snigdhaiḥ pravardhate| medaḥ pravṛddhaṃ 1dehaṃ ca vastiṃ ca kledayatyapi|| 2.6.7| yaśadā medasā klinnaḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| tasya prakupitaḥ śleṣmā pramehān kurute daśa|| 2.6.8| tadyathodakamehaṃ ca piṣṭamehaṃ tathaiva ca| evamādīṃstathānyāṃśca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.6.9| sphaṭikāmbunibhaṃ mūtramudamehī pramehati| śuklapiṣṭanibhaṃ cāpi piṣṭamehī pramehati|| 2.6.10| 1kāṇḍekṣurasamehī ca mehatīkṣurasopamam| mūtraṃ śuklopamaṃ cāpi śuklamehī tu mehati|| 2.6.11| ityetāṃścaturo mehāñjānīyātkevalātkaphāt| śleṣmaṇyanubale1 pitte ye mehanti tu tāñchṛṇu|| 2.6.12| lavaṇāmbunibhaṃ mūtraṃ vidyāllavaṇamehinaḥ| pramehati tathā jantuśurāmehī surākṛti|| mūtraṃ sāndraṃ prasannaṃ tu dṛśyate 1sāndramehinaḥ| ................................................. ................................................. 1iti bhele nidāne ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| ................................................... ................................................... gītāni bhajate nityaṃ pittonmādanipīḍitaḥ1|| 2.7.1| yaśadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate|| 2.7.2| sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa| ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ|| 2.7.3| sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ puruṣastāni tāni viceṣṭate| gāyannṛtyati caikatra hasatyatha ca roditi|| 2.7.4| ekatrāste vinā lokaṃ 1śete cāpi jaḍo yathā| janaṃ 1bhīṣayate cāpi śleṣmonmādī pumāniha|| 2.7.5| yastvetat sarvamaśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam| sannipātāttathonmādaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati|| 2.7.6| sa yadā dhananāśena maraṇena priyasya vā| atha cintayate, tasya saṃjñā bhraśyati cintayā|| 2.7.7| sa cintayati yān 1bhāvāṃstāneva pralapatyatha| āgantuṃ pañcamaṃ vidyādityunmādaṃ śarīriṇām|| 2.7.8| sarvānetān vijānīyādunmādānvai1 cikitsitāt| duḥkhena 1saṃjñābhraṣṭo hi prakṛtiṃ punar ṛcchati|| 2.7.9| evaṃ śarīrajā doṣāḥ śarīre paryavasthitāḥ| śarīrameva hiṃsanti pāvakaḥ svamivāśrayam|| 2.7.10| 1na hi satvāni hiṃsanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ| 1devāstathā dharmaśīlāḥ madhyasthā manujānprati|| 2.7.11| vamane recane yukto 1nirūhe cānuvāsane| na jātu dāruṇān rogānunmādān prāpnuyānnaraḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele nidāne saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto 'pasmāranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 2.8.1| vātātpittātkaphāccaiva sannipātāttathaiva1 ca| apasmārā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam|| 2.8.2| yaśadā vātalo janturvātalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| vyāyāmaṃ sevate cāpi tasya vātaḥ prakupyati|| 2.8.3| sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa| ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ|| 2.8.4| sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantānkaṭakaṭāyate| utphālayati netre ca 1bhruvau prakṣipate tathā|| 2.8.5| sa cetpratyāgato brūyāttamasaḥ parato gataḥ| pratibhāti ca me kṛṣṇā jagatī khaṇḍaṇastathā|| 2.8.6| tadordhvamevaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāyurvarcopadhāvati| ityetairlakṣaṇairvidyādapasmāraṃ tu vātajam|| 2.8.7| yaśadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate 'śanam| agnyātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ pravardhate|| 2.8.8| tad vṛddhamūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa| ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ|| 2.8.9| sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantānkaṭakaṭāyate| utphālayati netre ca bhruvāvutkṣipate tathā|| 2.8.10| sa cetpratyāgato brūyāttamasaḥ parato gataḥ| pratibhāti ca me śuklā jagatī khaṇḍaśastathā|| 2.8.11| tadordhvamevaṃ hṛdayaṃ 1kapho varcopadhāvati| ityetairlakṣaṇairvidyādapasmāraṃ kaphātmakam|| 2.8.12| yastvetatsarvamaśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam| sannipātādapasmāraṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati|| 2.8.13| evaṃ 1rasairihāpathyairvibṛddheṣvanilādiṣu| nā 'pasmārayate 1prāṇī na satvairupahanyate|| 2.8.14| yadā yadābhivardhante doṣāḥ 1parvasvivodadhiḥ| tadā tadāpasmarati naiṣa kliśyati santatam|| 2.8.15| jvarasya śoṣagulmānāṃ kāsināmatha kuṣṭhinām| pramehonmādināṃ caiva tathāpasmāriṇāmapi|| 2.8.16| ityaṣṭau vai pradiṣṭāni nidānāni śarīriṇām| vimānāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthānaṃ samāptam||
||vimānasthānam||
||prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto rasavimānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 3.1.1| śarīraṃ dhārayantīha ṣaḍrasāḥ 1samamāhṛtāḥ| ato 'nyathā vikārāṃstu janayanti śarīriṇām|| 3.1.2| rūkṣo laghuḥ 1sthiraśśītaḥ kaṣāyastikta eva ca| tīkṣṇoṣṇāvamlalavaṇau 1kaṭurvāpi 1vikāśyatha|| 3.1.3| śītaḥ snigdho gururbalyaḥ picchilo madhuro rasaḥ| 1kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaḥ śīto rūkṣo 'nilaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 3.1.4| rūkṣoṣṇamamlaṃ pittantu kaṭukaṃ ca pracakṣate| śleṣmā tu madhuraḥ snigdhaḥ śīto mandaḥ sthiro guruḥ|| 3.1.5| ityetān rasadoṣāṇāṃ sahotpannān guṇānviduḥ| tatra vāyuguṇaistulyān kaṣāyakaṭutiktakān|| 3.1.6| kaṭvamlalavaṇaistulyāṃstathā pittaguṇānviduḥ| madhuraṃ lavaṇāmlau ca vidyātkaphasamān rasān|| 3.1.7| tasmādabhyasyamānaistaiḥ śleṣmā dehe pravardhate| 1atraikatra kṛto 1rāśirdvirmahatvamiharcchati|| 3.1.8| guṇasāmyādvivardhante yathāsvaṃ dhātavo nṛṇām| rasaistadviparītaiśca yāntyete kṣayamāhṛtaiḥ|| 3.1.9| yathodakaṃ samāsādya śāntiṃ gacchati pāvakaḥ| kaṣāyatiktakaṭukai rūkṣo rūkṣairvivardhate|| 3.1.10| mārutaḥ snigdhabhāvaiśca tato 'nyairupaśāmyati| kaṭvamlalavaṇaiḥ pittamuṣṇamuṣṇairvivardhate|| 3.1.11| 1śītaiśśāmyati śeṣaistu guṇānāṃ 1hi viśeṣataḥ| snigdhaḥ snigdhaiḥ kaphaścāpi vardhate madhurādibhiḥ|| 3.1.12| rasaiḥ śāmyati rūkṣaiśca kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ| ekaikamekasāmānyādvardhayanti trayastrayaḥ|| 3.1.13| ghnanti cānyaguṇatvena rasā doṣaṃ śarīriṇām| na vāyuśaha tailena snehauṣṇyādvyapalīyate|| 3.1.14| śītatvānmadhuratvācca na pittaṃ saha sarpiṣā| raukṣyātkaṣāyabhāvācca 1snigdho madhura eva ca|| 3.1.15| na śleṣmā madhunā sārdhaṃ dehe paryavatiṣṭhate| ānūpamāṃsajā vāpi vasā majjāna eva ca|| 3.1.16| tailavanmārutaṃ 1ghnanti snehauṣṇyagurubhāvataḥ| śākādaviṣkirāṇāṃ ca rasā majjāna eva ca|| 3.1.17| 1ghṛtavad ghnanti te pittaṃ 1śītamādhuryabhāvataḥ| kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaṃ yacca kiñcidihauṣadham|| 3.1.18| madhuraṃ tatkaphaṃ hanti 1guṇānyatvena dehinām| atha 1nātyupayuñjīta pippalīṃ kṣārameva ca|| 3.1.19| lavaṇaṃ caiva, 1bahvetad bhuktaṃ doṣāya kalpate| śleṣmāṇaṃ cyāvayitvā tu notsahetāpakarṣitum|| 3.1.20| pippalī pākamadhurā tasmāttāṃ nātibhakṣayet| atyāhṛtā paceddehaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭubhāvataḥ|| 3.1.21| kṣāraṃ ca lavaṇaṃ caiva bhoktuṃ 1neheta kevalam| mātrāvaduṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ ca sātmyaṃ svādu ca bhojanam|| 3.1.22| avidāhi ca yat pāke jīrṇe tadupayojayet| balavarṇakaraṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ śleṣmānilāpaham|| 3.1.23| vidahyate na mātrā ca sātmyatāṃ ca karotyatha| svādu puṣṭikaraṃ jantoravidāhi prasādanam|| 3.1.24| nṛṇāmāyuṣkaraṃ caiva jīrṇe bhojanamiṣyate| na jalpanna hasaṃścāpi na drutaṃ na vilambitam|| 3.1.25| dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|| 4.2.1| .................... ....................... māno 'vatiṣṭhate| jātasya daśame māse nāmagotre namaskṛte|| 4.2.2| taruṇasya kumārasya vardhamāneṣu dhātuṣu| asthimajjasu pūrṇeṣu śukraṃ na pratipadyate|| 4.2.3| aṅgāṅgeṣu pravṛddheṣu pratimūleṣu dhātuṣu| śuklaṃ ca ṣoḍaśe varṣe suvyaktaṃ pratipadyate|| 4.2.4| tathā vṛddhasya jantośca parikṣīṇeṣu dhātuṣu| 1vivekā[1ma] na yathāpūrvaṃ vivicyante parikṣayāt|| 4.2.5| tato 'lparetā bhavati sujīrṇo durbalo 'thavā| na paśyati naraḥ śuklaṃ sarvadhātuparikṣayāt|| 4.2.6| raktaṃ māṃsaṃ 1vasāsthīni[1ca] majjā śuklaṃ tathānalaḥ| śakṛnmūtre ca tairmandaṃ vidyānnavatitaḥ param|| 4.2.7| iha narchati garbhaṃ strī vātenopahatā tathā| 1yonidoṣeṇa[1yā] cānnena na hi vandhyāsti nā ca na|| 4.2.8| vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva 1vastimāsthāpanaṃ[1vastirā] tathā| tasmāttatkārayetstrīṇāṃ prasiddhāḥ prasuvanti[1prasa] vai|| 4.2.9| athātra bhavati praśnaḥ 1kasmācchabdaṃ[1rasā chardiṃ] na nāsayā| 1gṛhṇāsyāsyena[1gṛhīṣvā] vā gandhaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatra khaṃ yadi|| 4.2.10| 1tvagbhāge[1tvadbhā] ca same kasmānna gṛhṇātyanyayā rasam| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca punarvasuḥ|| 4.2.11| ghrāṇaṃ gandhaṃ ca bhaumaṃ hi 1rūpaṃ[1rūkṣaṃ] cakṣuśca taijasam|saṃsparśaṃ sparśanaṃ vāyoḥ śrotraṃ 1śabdātmakhaṃ[1śabdātmakaṃ] tathā|| 4.2.12| rasanaṃ ca raso hy 1āpyaṃ[1vyā-] tasmādetairihendriyaiḥ| yathāsvaṃ tulyayogitvādviṣayagrahaṇaṃ smṛtam|| 4.2.13| svaṃ svaṃ hi viṣayaṃ dhāturvijānātyātmanānvitaḥ| ātmendriyamanorthānāṃ 1bandhācceti[1bandhiśce] samādiśa||

tadyathā khalvayaṃ puruṣo rasajanmā rasajīvī rasajvalano rasasamādhiko rasajīvanaśca bhavati| rasānāmasamyagupayogānmithyopayogāttadvikārānṛcchati| na kaścinmithyopayogādajīrṇāpathyabhojanātsvastho bhavati|| 4.4.2| athātra praśno bhavati| ko 'tra khalvasyāhāraṃ pacati vātaḥ pittaṃ śleṣmānupānaṃ veti| netyāha bhagavān punarvasurātreyaḥ| yadyete pākahetavaḥ syustarhi na kaścidiha durbalāgniḥ syādvātādīnāṃ sannihitatvāt, sānupānatvācca| athāsyoṣmā tejaśca śarīrasthamāhāraṃ pacataḥ| te kāyāgnir1 iti[1-agne] vidyāt|| 4.4.3| tatra bhela ātreyamidamuvāca---bhagavan| pañcadhā ye 1śārīrāḥ[1śārīrā] paṭhyante; ālocakarājakabhrājakasādhaka-1pācakabhedena[1vā]; teṣāṃ katham 1idaṃ[1idāṃ] pañcābhidhāyināṃ pṛthaktvaṃ bhavatīti|| 4.4.4| atrovāca bhagavānātreyaḥ tatrālocako nāma varṣaśītātapapravṛddhaḥ| sa dvividhaḥ| cakṣurvaiśeṣiko buddhivaiśeṣikaśceti| cakṣurvaiśeṣiko nāma ya ātmamanasośannikarṣajñānamudīrayitvā citte cittamapyādhāya saṃsvedajāṇḍajodbhijjajarāyujānāṃ caturṇāṃ bhūtagrāmāṇāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃsthānarūpavarṇasvarairuccāvacānāṃ puṣpaphalapatrāṇāṃ rūpanirvṛty 1arthamekaikasya[1arthamaikekaṃ dvau vā trayo vā] dvayostrayāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā yugapatpraṇipatitānāṃ cakṣuṣā *vaiśeṣyamutpādayatīti[1vaiṣamya]|| 4.4.5| buddhivaiśeṣiko nāma yo bhruvormadhye śṛṅgāṭakasthaḥ susūkṣmānarthānadhyātmakṛtān gṛhṇāti jñānena, jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ kṛtsnajñeyakaivalyārtheṣu darśayati| tasmād jñānajñeyaṃ jñātvā jñānaṃ gṛhṇāti| gṛhītaṃ dhārayati| dhāritaṃ pratyudāharati, atītaṃ smarati, pratyutpannaṃ kṛtvā 'nāgataṃ prārthayati, jātamātraśca punaranupadiṣṭasvabhāvaṃ mātṛstanyamabhilaṣati| dhyāne pratyāhāre yojanācca buddhivaiśeṣyamutpādayatīti|| 4.4.6| tatra bhrājako nāma yo 1hyasya[1yasya] śarīraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ copagamayati, prādhānyaṃ pradarśayati, śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarajaṅghāsyanakhanayanakeśānāṃ ca pratibhāvṛddhiviśeṣānutpādayati, bhrājayatīti bhrājakaḥ|| 4.4.7| prabhaviṣṇutvendriyaprābalyād budhyavasthāhaṃkāreṇa vā-1abhimatarthamarthebhya[1abhimate] ātmakṛtamādhate| cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇarasanasparśanavākpāṇipādapāyūpasthebhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ viṣayārthānāṃ svabhāvoparaktānāṃ parasparebhyo rāgamutpādayatīti| antarmadhye ca pittasthānamantaraṃ praviśya rāgaṃ janayatīti 1rājakaḥ[1rājakam]|| 4.4.8| sādhako nāma 1yaḥ[1yā] śabdasparśagandhebhyo 'rthakāmebhyaśca devapitṛṛṣibhyaśca iha cāmutrakāṇāṃ ca pādārthānāṃ viśreyasama?dhikṛtya sarvapadārthā 1nāpnoti[1nāṃ nūti] svayuktyā sādhayatīti sādhakaḥ|| 4.4.9| pācako nāma aśitapītalīḍhakhāditamāhārajātaṃ jātanīryaṃ 1pācayatīti[1 - -ca] pācakaḥ| yaḥ svakaṃ kāmamevāgniṃ prapūrayati harṣayati|| 4.4.10| bhavanti cātra--- yo 'yaṃ nirdahati kṣipramāhāraṃ sarvadehinām| apānamadyanidanaḥ? kāyāgniḥ 1paripaṭhyate[1pariparyate]|| 4.4.11| 1prabhāvalakṣyaśaṃyukto[1-lakṣyasati] jīvasyeha sanātanaḥ| nābhimadhye śarīrasya vijñeyaṃ somamaṇḍalam|| 4.4.12| somamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ vidyāttat sūryamaṇḍalam| pradīpavaccāpi nṛṇāṃ tasya madhye hutāśanaḥ|| 4.4.13| dehinā bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ nānāvyañjanasaṃskṛtam| sūryo divi yathā tiṣṭhan tejoyukto gabhastibhiḥ|| 4.4.14| viśoṣayati sarvāṇi palvalāni payāṃsi ca | tadvaccharīriṇāṃ 1vyaktaṃ[1bhuktaṃ] jāṭharo nābhisaṃsthitaḥ|| 4.4.15| mayūkhaiḥ kṣipramādatte sūryakānto maṇiryathā| kṣipraṃ samyak pradahati gomayaṃ kāṣṭhameva ca|| 4.4.16| sthūlakāyeṣu sattveṣu yavamātrapramāṇataḥ| hrasvakāyeṣu sattveṣu truṭimātrapramāṇataḥ|| 4.4.17| krimikīṭapataṅgeṣu vāyumātro 'vatiṣṭhati| yastaṃ 1cikitsetsīdantaṃ[1cikitsiddhantaṃ] vyādhinā cāpi dehinām|| 4.4.18| āyurvedābhiyogena sa vai kāyacikitsakaḥ| rasaṃ ca śoṇitaṃ caiva medo māṃsamathāpi ca|| 4.4.19| mahatyanaśane nYṇāṃ sarvāṇyetāni khādati| agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam|| 4.4.20| agnīṣomātmakāḥ sarve dehinastu caturvidhāḥ| sūryātmakāni 1sarvāṇi[1cāndrāṇi] tathā somātmakāni ca|| 4.4.21| mahatyanaśane nYṇāṃ tenāntrāṇi 1sa[1na] khādati| jāṭharo jalasambhūtaḥ pāvakaḥ pavanaiśaha|| 4.4.22| pradīpyate nṛṇāṃ koṣṭhe sati vendhanapūritaḥ| 1ikṣvākukośam[1śoka] āsthāya yathā dīpaḥ sthire 'mbhasi|| 4.4.23| tiṣṭhate timire sakto na tathā calite 'mbhasi| evaṃ śarīriṇāṃ 1koṣṭhe[1rūṣṭhe] vaikṛtena punaḥ punaḥ|| 4.4.24| agnirvaiṣamyamāpnoti pūryamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ| sa ca yatnena vai rakṣyo 1vipanne[1vipanno] doṣadarśanāt| 1chardyate[1dviyarta] cātisāryeta vikāraṃ cāyamṛcchati|| 4.4.25| 1asāvasamprāptakālo[1śvāsaṃ] ya evaṃ mriyate, varṣaśataṃ hi puruṣāyustaccānāptuṃ jīrṇalaghupathyabhojanānuvartinā bhavitavyamiti|| 4.4.26| tatrāha kasmād 1alasakaviṣūcikāvān[1-viṣūcikāvasādhyaye vāgavi] sadya evāgadī bhavati kaścinmriyata iti? atrāha---rūkṣasyādhyaśanena-1utpīḍitā[1utpiti] 1vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ[1-śleṣmāṇi] ūrdhvamadho vā nānulomā bhavanti, udvṛttaistatra taiḥ sadya eva mriyate| snigdhasyādhyaśamotpīḍitā vātādayaḥ ūrdhvamadho vā+1anulomāḥ[1anulomāṃsvāṅgasāṃstu] svāṅgadeśāṃstu pradadyante, tatra taiḥ sadya evāgadī bhavati|| 4.4.27| atha 1daśāntarguhāḥ[1-antahānta], daśa bahirguṇāḥ?| tadyathā---dvicakṣuṣī dvināsike dve 1śravasī kaṇṭhanāḍīgudameḍhravāyusrotāṃsīti[1srotasī kaṇṭhanābhi-] daśa antarguhāḥ| daśa dhamanyo 1hṛdaye[1hṛdayaṃ] nibaddhā bhavanti| tāḥ 1prabhave[1prabhavaṃ] caturaṃgulamātraṃ gatvā viṃśatirbhavanti|evametā daśa dhamanyaḥ ṣaṣṭirbhavanti| tatra tu 1bhavanti[1bhavantutrī] trīṇi śatasahasrāṇi 1ṣaṣṭiriyaṃ[1ṣahtaṃśāli] jālāni sirāṇāṃ| tadyathā---1vṛkṣaḥ[1vṛkṣa] 1śākhāvṛtaḥ[1śākhāvṛta] phalapalāśairavatarati sarvatra| tadyathā vā 1hāgo[1hanyo]+1aśmabhiratataḥ[1aśmabhirataraḥ] 1tathāyaṃ[1tatāyaṃ] sirābhiravatataḥ| romakūpe 1romakūpe[1rūpakūpe] hyasya sirāmukhaṃ bhavati, yataḥ 1svedaḥ[1svetaḥ] 1kṣaratīti[1kṣiratīti]|| 4.4.28| tatrāha kasmādayaṃ puruṣo na santatamapasmaratīti? atrocyate---yathā saritāṃ prādurbhāve vārijāni sattvāni prādurbhavanti hāse vā hasanti| yadā yadā rasavegaṃ prāpnuvanti tadā tadā apasmārayanti| tasmād dvyahāttryahāt pakṣānmāsāntarāccāpasmarante|| 4.4.29| kecidrakṣopahata ityāhuḥ, taccāyuktam| yadi hyevaṃ syād dṛśyeran puruṣaśarīre prahārādīni vā| 1tataśca[1tastaccha] naivam| 1vetālābhibhūta[1velāvabhūta] iti cettacāpyanupapannam| puṇyāni hyeṣāṃ 1manāṃsi[1vanāṃsi] 1dhyāyanti[1dhyāyantye]| yadi caivaṃ kadācidbhavati| tasmāttadeva pāṭhyaṃ rasopahatamiti cedevameva| rasapravivekakāle tṛtīyakacaturthakāva 1pi[1va] dṛśyete jvarāvapi|neṣatrāṃ hyananārthaḥ?|| 4.4.30| atrāha kiṃ 1khalvasya[1jalpa] garbhasya prathamaṃ sambhavati? 1hastau[1hastaṃ] pādāviti 1baḍiśaḥ tat1pratiṣṭhitatvāt[1pratiṣṭatāt] 1śarīrasya[1śaīraśva]| paścādguda iti śaunakaḥ tadāśritatvādvāyoḥ| nābhiriti khaṇḍakāpyaḥ tatra nāḍīnāṃ 1pratiṣṭhitatvāt[1pratiṣṭa]| hṛdayamiti parāśaraḥ vijñānamūlakānāṃ tanmūlatvāt| śira iti bharadvājaḥ śarīrasya tanmūlatvāt| cakṣuriti kāśyapaḥ| netyāha bhagavānpunarvasurātreyaḥ| tasmādarbudamevāsya prathamaṃ sambhavati| tatra sarve śarīrapradeśāśambhavanti arbudasnehotpannāḥ|| 4.4.31| atrāha---kiṃ 1nu[1tu] 1garbho[1garvo] 1māturudarastho 'śnāti[1māturastho] na veti| atrocyate nāśnāti| yadi hyaśnīyāt syād 1asya[1asyā puruṣa] purīṣamatītakālaṃ, na 1cedamasti[1cedasi]| kathaṃ tarhi? nābhyāṃ nāḍī pratiṣṭhitā tasyāmaparā māturhṛdayamāśritā tayā māturannaraso 'bhivahan garbhaṃ prīṇayatyabhivardhayati| tadyathā kulyāḥ kedāramabhisaṃśrayantyo bhāvayanti tadvat|| 4.4.32| tatrāha kathaṃ garbho māturudare tiṣṭhatīti| ūrdhvamiti śaunakaḥ| avākchirā iti bharadvājaḥ| netyāha bhagavānpunarvasurātreyaḥ| yadyūrdhvaṃ tiṣṭhet tarhi mātṛghātī syāt| yadyavākchirāḥ svaghātī syāt| kathaṃ tarhi? tiryak sarvairayamaṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ pratibhugnaḥ śete|| 1tasya tadananataraṃ tatprathamaṃ pratipadyate [1sandarbheṇānena pratipipādayiṣito 'rthaḥ na spaṣṭaḥ]| tasmāttasya śiraḥ prathamaṃ punarvasurātreyaḥ pratipadyate| tadasya gurutaraṃ bhavatīti| atha khalu vṛkko medo gururiti saṃpravṛddhau parasparamabhivardhayanti|| 4.4.33| tatra ślokaḥ, ūṣmā rasastho dehe 'smiñjīvanaṃ gṛhya tiṣṭhati| rasodbhavaḥ pumāṃstasmādraso jīvanamucyate|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ|
iti bhele śārīre caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
athātaḥ śarīranicayaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 4.5.1| iha khalvojastejaḥ śarīre nitye 1ca[1va] bhavataḥ | 1tayoḥ[1teyo] sthānāni dvādaśa bhavanti| tadyathā---1tvakśoṇita[1vaśoṇīta]-māṃsamedo 'sthimajjāśuklasvedapittaśleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇīti| tānyavyāpannāni sukhamityucyate| 1vyāpannaistu[1vyāpannestu] vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ praduṣṭā rasādiṣu vikārānupajanayanti|| 4.5.2| atha yonayaścatasro bhavanti| tadyathā---jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasvedajāśceti| tatra jarāyujā 1jarāyuyuktāśaṃbhavanti[1-yu] paśumṛgamanuṣyādayaḥ| śakuna-1matsya[1macha]-kacchapa-1sarpa[1sarva]-prabhṛtayoṇḍajāḥ| yūkāmat-1kuṇa[1kupa]-pataṅgāśiviṣamakṣikādayaḥ svedajāḥ| udbhijjāstu tṛṇalatāvṛkṣavanaspataya iti|| 4.5.3| tatra puṣpaphalavanto vṛkṣāḥ| apuṣpaphalavanto vanaspatayaḥ| sapuṣpāḥ saphalāścāpuṣpāścāphalāśca bīrudhaḥ| phalapākā latāścauṣadhayaḥ| tatra ye śvetakṣīrāḥ saumyāḥ, raktakṣīrāḥ kādrā vāruṇā vāligrahā? iti|| 4.5.4| iha khalu triṣu daśarātreṣu pumān rasena saṃyujyate| āsāṃ tu khalu catasṛṇāṃ yonīnāṃ ṛtukāle yadā rasāḥ samyak prāptiṃ vā gacchanti tadā garbhaḥ 1tiṣṭhaty[1tiṣṭe] avikṛtaḥ viparyaye viparyayaḥ|| 4.5.5| 1tryahantu[1-ha] khalu purāṇarudhiraṃ parivarjayet| kiñca tatpurāṇam? yadāditastryahaṃ parisravadṛtukāle tatpurāṇam| tasmin tryahe garbha-1upakramaṇe[1upakrameṇa] na tiṣṭhati| 1avasthito[1avasthi vā] vā nāyuṣi samartho bhavati| 1nirgate[1nirgave] tu tryaheṇa purāṇe rudhire 1cāvasthite[1ṇa] śuddhasnātāyāścaturthaṣaṣṭha-1aṣṭama[1aṣṭa]-daśama-1dvādaśeṣu[1dvādaśamu] ahaśu garbhovakramamāṇaḥ pumān bhavati| pañcamasaptama-1navamaikādaśeṣu[1-navaikādaśu] strītvāyopakalpate|sa eṣa āsaptarātrātsarvasañcāro 'bhidadhatyataḥ paramasañcārovakṛtatvādvālpāt?|| 4.5.6| strīṇāṃ khalu śoṇitaṃ śarīraṃ śoṣayati tasmānna tāḥ rajaḥ paśyanti| paripūrṇadhātuśarīrāstu yadā bhavanti tadā vivekajalalohitaṃ māse māse prativedayanti| pratigatapraveśaṃ ca tatpunarmāsena samāgacchatyārtavam|| 4.5.7| yadā tu tacchoṇitaṃ duṣṭaṃ mārgaṃ pratipadyate tadā strīṇāṃ pradaro bhavati| taṃ śarīraṃ 1śoṣayantaṃ[1śoṣaya] lohitapittabheṣajenopakrameta|| 4.5.8| garbhiṇyāstu tridhā kāye raso 'bhinirvartate, 1garbhatvāya[1garbhātpā] stanyatvāya rasatvāya ceti|| 4.5.9| iha khalu bhoḥ 1garbhātsthirādantaḥsthādāyatamudaraṃ[1-sthitāvasthātamā] bhavati madhye nāryāmantargatāyām| sthūlamūlasaṃsthitasaṃvṛttamacchidraṃ puruṣo 'ntargate| 1droṇīvodaraṃ[1droṇicodaraṃ] bhavatyubhayorantargatayoḥ| vāmaṃ pārśvamāyataṃ māturudarasthā strī, dakṣiṇe pumān, madhye napuṃsakam| vāmamakṣi hrasati nāryāmantargatāyām, puruṣe dakṣiṇam, ubhe napuṃsake| savyaṃ pādaṃ pūrvaṃ prakrāmati savyena cākṣṇā bhruvā ca pūrvaṃ prati kurute, ceṣṭate 1ca[1na] 1savyena[1sarvena] pārśvena prāyaḥ 1saṃviśati[1śaṃsate] strīsaṃjñāneṣu ca prāyaśo dauhṛdaṃ kurute nāryāmantargatāyām| viparyaye tadataḥ puruṣaṃ bibhartīti vidyāt|| 4.5.10| atha 1iha[1ye] khalu garbhasya ṣaḍbhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīramabhinirvartate| tadyathā---jalakāyādvāyukāyāttejaḥkāyāt pṛthivīkāyādākāśakāyādrasakāyācceti|| 4.5.11| ṣaḍdhāturevāyaṃ puruṣo bhavati| dhātavaḥ punaḥ pañca bhūtāni brahma 1yadavyaktam[1padavyaktam]|| 4.5.12| tatra yat kharakaṭhinam, tadyathā---dantakeśaroma-1nakha[1mukha]-purīṣasnāyvasthi, gandhajñānaghrāṇasaṅghātagauravāṇīti| yad dravaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛdu vā tadaudakam|| 4.5.13| 1tadyadā[1tadyamu] sannipatitayoryatra puruṣaḥ 1pūrvamarthaṃ[1sarvamardha] nandayati jaghanyaṃ strī tatra 1pumānihāṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ[1pumānipratyaṅgaiḥ] sadṛśo jāyate| yatra tu strī prathamamarthaṃ sādhayati jaghanyaṃ puruṣaḥ, tatra strī vāṅgapratyaṅgais 1sadṛśī[1sadṛśo] jāyate|| 4.5.14| atha 1strīpuruṣāvṛtukāle[1-nāle] rūkṣāṇi 1vātalānyannāni[1vātaśānyannāni] sevete, vegāṃśca dhārayataḥ, tayorgarbhaḥ śoṇitādiṣu vātasaṃdūṣiteṣu 1niḥsṛto[1viḥsṛto] bhavati, gadgadabādhiryaminmiṇatvamanyeṣāṃ ca vātapittavikārāṇāmanyatamaṃ prāpnoti| evameva pittaśleṣmalānṛtukāle mātāpitroḥ sevamānayoḥ pittaśleṣmavidūṣito garbhaḥ sambhavati|| 4.5.15| atha khalu garbhaśarīraṃ catrudaśendriyakāyāḥ samanupraviśanti| vidhṛtāścānupalabhyamānāśca saptadivyāḥ saptamānuṣāḥ|| 4.5.16| tatra divyāḥ 1brahmadeva[1brahmadevataṃ]-varuṇagandharvapiśācāsuramahārajakāyā bhavanti| tān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| tatra yaḥ satyārjavānṛśaṃsakṣamādam-1adhyāna[1advāyāna]-sampanno 'dhyātmatattvadarśī bhavati taṃ brahmakāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.17| yastādyaśīlopādānayadyatraiyavān? muditastaṃ deva kāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.18| yo yajñananditarāgadṛṣṭiḥ salilapriyaścirasnāyī piṅgākṣaḥ kapilakeśaḥ saṃbhavati taṃ varuṇakāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.19| yastu priyanṛtyagītavāditraḥ strīvihāranityaḥ śucivastragandhamālyānulepanaratirbhavati taṃ gandharvakāyāmiti vidyāt|| 4.5.20| yastu priyamadyamāṃsamatsyastathā gomahāśano bībhatso bālānāṃ bhīṣayitā nidrābahulaśca bhavati taṃ piśācakāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.21| 1yastvātmagurūṇāṃ[1-gu] mānayitā paścād dveṣī caṇḍaḥ krodhano jñātīnāṃ bhedako bhavati tamāsuraṃ kāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.22| yastu dhīraḥ śūraḥ mahābhogo mahotsāho mahaiśvaryaśca bhavati taṃ mahārājakāyamiti vidyāt|| 4.5.23| anurāgeṇa mānuṣāstu pratyātmadarśanaśravaṇasparśanarasanaghrāṇasukhaduḥkhamiti tatpravidyāsahitāḥ kevalāścāvatiṣṭhante kārtsnyena|tairanvito janturliṅgati nimiṣati ākuṃcati prasārayati vedyaṃ vedayate|| 4.5.24| 1sa[1na] yadā bhedaṃ gacchati 1tadāyamantataḥ[1tathāyaḥ antaḥ kāyameva yānti] jalaṃ jalakāyameva yāti, vāyurvāyukāyaṃ, tejaḥ tejaḥkāyaṃ, pṛthivī pṛthivīkāyaṃ, ākāśamākāśakāyamiti| 1yathākāyam[1dāyam]-1indriyakāyaṃ[1-kālaṃ] bhajate|| 4.5.25| bhavati cātra--- vidyamāne śarīre vai dhāturdhātuṃ niyacchati | mano buddhiśca sarveṣāṃ brahmaṇi pratitiṣṭhati|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ|
iti bhele śārīre pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||
athātaḥ khaḍḍikāṃ garbhāvakrāntiṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 4.6.1| iha khalu bho mātṛjaścāyaṃ garbhaḥ pitṛjaścātmajaśca sātmyajaśca rasajaśca| asti ca sattvam 1aupapādakam[1aupavādakam] ityātreyavacanam| neti bharadvājaḥ | amātṛjaścāyaṃ garbhaḥ apitṛjaścānātmajaśca-1asātmyajaś[1anātmajaś] cārasajaśca| nāsti ca sattvam 1aupapādakam[1aupavādhikam] iti| yadi hi mātā putraṃ janyet bhūyiṣṭhaṃ hi strī putrakāmā maithunavargamabhisandhāya putraṃ janayet strīkāmā ca striyam|| 4.6.2| 1yadā[1-vi] jīvena saha sūkṣmāvagnimārutau garbhaṃ viśataḥ 1tadā[1-va] dvāvetāvaṅgapratyaṅgāni vikurutaḥ,tau 1ceṣṭayataḥ[1ceṣṭataḥ], tau vardhayataḥ, tāveva yadā śarīrād vyavakrāmataḥ tadā tadbhavati nirvāto nirūṣmā preto mṛta iti| netyāha bharadvājaḥ| mṛto 'pi jantuḥ vāyunādhmāṣyate, agninā śoṣyate| netyāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| saha vā tasyāgnimārutau jīvayataḥ, tayor 1apakrāntayor[1apakrāntayorvātya] bahyāgnimārutāvāviśata iti|| 4.6.3| yatpunarāḥ sati ca 1bhūtanānātve[1bhūtarnātve] kathamekaḥ syāditi? atrocyate| yatraitannānātvamāśritaṃ tadetadavyaktamasti pañcamahābhūtasaṃgraha iti|| 4.6.4| yatpunarāha 1yadyavyaktaṃ sarvaṃ syādavikāraḥ syād iti[1ya---sa vivasyādadhi], atrocyate| vātapittaśleṣmakṛtā rasasamutthā asya vyaktāḥ procyante vikārāḥ, avyakte hyukte 1te[1rute] vyaktāḥ kathamavyaktaṃ *srakṣyanti, kathaṃ tarhi śarīre tadvikriyate, unmādaḥ kathamavyaktaṃ manaḥ 1spṛśatīty[1spṛśatithena] etaccānupapannam| kiṃ tarhi yathādityaśambhūto 'pi 1meghāntarito[1memāmtarito] na prakāśamupajanayati 1tathā[1---] mano 'ntarhiteṣu vijñānasrotaśu tamasā smṛtiṃ nopajanayatīti|| 4.6.5| yatpunarāḥ yadyayaṃ paralokād 1garbho 'vakrāmennāsya[1garma ukta] kiñcittatrādṛṣṭaṃ syāditi, atrocyate| iha tāvadayaṃ cirotsṛṣṭāni vijñānāni vividhāni cāścaryabhūtāni na smarati kiṃ punardehāntarāṇi bhūtāni bhāvaviśeṣā-1antarāṇi[1---]|| 4.6.6| tatra ślokaḥ--- tamasā bhāvito yo vai saṃsmarenna sa mānavaḥ| saṃsmaretpūrvacaritaṃ sukṛte 1vedavad[1vedavidṛja] dvijaḥ||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele śārīre ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
athātaḥ śarīrasaṃkhyāśārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 4.7.1| iha khalu śarīre ṣaṭ tvaco bhavanti| udakadharā prathamā 'sṛgdharā dvitīyā, 1sidhmakilāsasaṃbhava[1maṃ] adhiṣṭhānā tṛtīyā, dadrukuṣṭhasambhavādhiṣṭhānā caturthī, alajīvidridhisambhavādhiṣṭhānā pañcamī, ṣaṣṭhī tu yasyāṃ chinnāyāmuttāmyati timiramivānupraviśati duṣṭāruṣkāṇi cāsya yāmāśritya jāyante iti|| 4.7.2| asthigaṇanā---trīṇi 1saṣaṣṭīni[1saṣaṣṭhiṇi śavā] śatānyasthnāṃ tadyathā---dvātriṃśaddantāḥ, dvātriṃśaddantolūkhalāni, 1viṃśatirnakhāḥ[1paṇipādaśalānānyaṅgulyasthīni], ṣaṣṭiḥ pāṇipādāṅgulyasthīni, viṃśatiḥ pāṇipādaśalākāḥ, catvāri pāṇīpādaśalākādhiṣṭhānāni, dve 1pārṣṇyorasthinī[1pārṣorasthīni], catvāraḥ pādayoḥ gulphāḥ, dvau maṇikau, māṇike dve hastayoḥ, 1catvāryaratnyorasthīni[1catvāryaśayo], dve jaṅghayoḥ, dve jānunī, dve jānukapālike, 1dvāvūrunalakau[1dāvūrudvāvūrunaśaktau], dvāvaṃsau, dve aṃsaphalake, dvāvakṣakau, ekaṃ jatru, dve tālunī, dve cibuke, dve śroṇiphalake, ekaṃ bhagāsthi, pañcacatvāriṃśat 1pṛṣṭhagatānyasthīni[1pṛṣṭhagatau dhṛsthini], pañcadaśa grīvāyām, caturdaśorasi, caturviṃśatiḥ parśukāḥ pārśvayoḥ, 1tāvanti[1yāvanti] caiva sthālakāni, tāvanti caiva sthālakārbudakāni, ekaṃ hanvasthi, dve hanubandhane, ekaṃ nāsāsthi-1hanu[1tathā hanu]-kūṭalalāṭam, catvāri śīrṣakapālāni|| 4.7.3| hṛdayamekaṃ cetanāyatanam| daśa prāṇāyatanāni tadyathā---mūrdhā kaṇṭho hṛdayaṃ gudo nābhirvastirojaḥ śauklaṃ śoṇitaṃ māṃsamiti|| 4.7.4| pañcadaśa 1koṣṭhāṅgāni[1koṣṭhāni]| tadyathā---nābhiśca hṛdayaṃ ca kloma ca yakṛcca plīhā ca vṛkkau ca vastiśca purīṣādhānaṃ cāmāśayaścottaragudaścādharagudaśca kṣudrāntraṃ ca sthūlāntraṃ ca vapāvahanaṃ ceti|| 4.7.5| ṣaṭpañcāśatpratyaṅgāni tadyathā---dvau gulphau, dve nitambe, dve jaṅghe, dve piṇḍike, dve ūrupiṇḍike, dvau sphicau, dvau vṛṣaṇau, ekaṃ śephaḥ, dvau śaṅkhau, dvau baṅkṣṇau, dvau kukundarau, eko vastiḥ, śīrṣamekamudaramekam, dvau stanau, dvau bāhū, dvāṃvasakau, ekaṃ cubukaṃ, dvāvoṣṭhau, dve dantaveṣṭe, dve 1sṛkvaṇī[1sṛkvaṇīti], ekaṃ tālu, galaśuṇḍikā ekā, dvau karṇau, dve karṇaśaṣkulike, dvau gaṇḍau, dve akṣikūṭe, catvāryakṣivartmāni, dve 1akṣiṇī[1akṣiṇīti] iti|| 4.7.6| śarīradravyāṇī---daśodakasyāñjalayaḥ śarīre pracyavamānaṃ purīṣamanubadhvātyatiyoge, navāñjalayaḥ pūrvasyāhārapariṇāmadhātoryantaṃ rasa ity 1ācakṣate[1ācakṣati] kuśalāḥ, aṣṭau śoṇitasya, sapta purīṣasya, catvāro mūtrasya, dvau medasaḥ, eko majjñaḥ, mastiṣkasyāñjaliḥ śuklasya ceti|| 4.7.7| athātra praśno bhavati--- katamayaṃ 1jīvo[1devo] dehāddehāntaramupakramata iti? atrovāca bhagavānātreyaḥ| jalūkāyā ivāsya kecidgatiṃ bruvate| tanna yuktam| iha vyaktyantāmūrtaṃ yugapatsyādevāpare 'pyevamicchanti| sarvathāpi mumukṣorasyāyamantarātmā paramupakramata iti sarvathāpyasmin parityakte paricaye tāvadasaṃprāptaṃ tarā syāt| avasthānatvāccettadiṣṭaṃ karmaṇopyevaṃ bhavati vaiyyarthyamapi tu khalu pratiśrutyāpahitaḥ paratra gamanaṃ tasya vidyāt| athavā yathādityasya hṛdaye bhūmau raśmayaḥ pratitiṣṭhante| vilambitāvevamatasya tatra gamanamanupaścediti|| 4.7.8| atha khalu 1puruṣe[1puruṣā] ṣoḍaśādhyātmadevatā bhavanti| tadyathā---agniśca pṛthivī cāpaścākāśaśca vāyuśca vidyucca parjanyaśca 1indraśca[1-ga] gandharvaśca mṛtyuścādityaśca candramāśca 1tvaṣṭā[1tṛṣṇā] ca viṣṇuśca prajāpatiśca brahmā ceti| tāḥ karmabhirvidyādutpattitaśca parimāṇataśca vidyāt| ūṣmā hy 1atrāagneś[1-gniś] ca karma dehe| ghrāṇaṃ ca pṛthivyāḥ, sneho raso jñānaṃ codakasya, sparśanaṃ vāyoḥ, śrotraṃ cākāśasya, rūpādānaṃ parjanyasya saṃvegādānāni vidyutaḥ, balamindrasya, kāmo gandharvāṇāṃ, kopo mṛtyoḥ, cakṣurādityasya, *prasādaścandramasaḥ, rūpaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ, ceṣṭā viṣṇoḥ, vyavāyaḥ prajāpateḥ, buddhirbrahmaṇa iti|| 4.7.9| tatra ślokaḥ--- viśuddhanetrāstapaso munayaḥ śāntakalmaṣāḥ| jagataścopapannāṃśca 1sarvān[1svarbhā] paśyanti mānavān|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ|
iti bhele śārīre saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
athāto jātisūtrīyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 4.8.1| iha khalu bhoḥ yāḥ striyaḥ pathyalaghubhojinyo 'nudāvartanaśīlā apraduṣṭā yathāgarbhāśayāḥ suviśuddhasrotaso bhavanti, tā ācakṣate avandhyāḥ iti kuśalāḥ| tā iṣṭarūpaṃ medhāvi cāpatyaṃ janayanti, viparyaye viparyayaḥ|| 4.8.2| ṛtau ca garbho 'vatiṣṭhate| tadyathā---sukṛṣṭakṣetre bījaṃ prakṣiptaṃ tatra vrīhiḥ vrīhitvāya kalpate, yavo yavatvāya 1evameva[1priya] indriyamṛtukāle 1visṛṣṭamaduṣṭāyāṃ[1-māmaṭṭa] yonau garbhāśayamupagacchati| 1tadyathā[1tadyathāya]---āvartagṛhītāḥ pratīpaṃ pratidhāvanti tadvat śuklaśoṇitaṃ 1garbhāśaye[1garbhāśaya astikaṃ] āsiktaṃ kṣīramiva| 1taccānekakanakamiva[1taṃ cānekanakamivo]-udumbareṇa niṣiktamekatvamāpannamṛddhiṃ labhate|| 4.8.3| sā ced 1evamākāṅkṣetaudvāhike[1evayā kāṃkṣā-] śivāvadātaputraṃ 1janayeyam[1janayanti] iti, yavānāṃ 1manthaṃ[1mandaṃ] sarpiśamyuktaṃ saptarātramanupahataṃ bhuñjīta| tato 1dauhṛdinī[1dauhṛtdvi] śvetāyā goḥ sarūpavatsāyāḥ payasi pāyasaṃ pācayitvā 1tadevāśnīyāt[1-atmīyāt]| śukle ca vāsasī 1paridadhyāt[1parirabhyāt]| sarvaśvetaṃ cāsyāḥ saṃskṛtaṃ vimānaṃ kārayet| 1vṛṣabhamaśvaṃ[1vṛṣabhagaga] vāsyā darśayet| evamavadātaṃ putraṃ janayet| netyāha śaunakaḥ| paiṅgalyaṃ vā tato 'pyatreti| ātreya uvāca kiṃ syādāvādhakam, piṅgalāvayavayā āyuṣmanto nīrogāśca bhavantīti|| 4.8.4| sā 1cedevam[1iti hā] 1āśāsīta[1āsita] śyāmaṃ lohitākṣaṃ putraṃ 1janayeyam[1jana yetre yāvat dvitīye māsapuṣpaṃ paśyet yamiti] iti 1eṣāmeva[1eṣāma] yavānāṃ 1manthaṃ[1mandaṃ] kārayet lohitakukkuṭaraktena saptarātraṃ raktaśālīnāmodanamanupahataṃ bhuñjīta| dauhṛde sā tāmreṇa ca vāsasā paridadhyāt| tāmre cāsyāḥ śayanāsane dadyād 1raktavṛṣamaśvaṃ[1-vṛṣamadaṃ] vāsyā darśayet| evaṃ śyāmaṃ lohitākṣaṃ putraṃ janayati|| 4.8.5| 1yā[1yāvad] vi dvitīyamāsi puṣpaṃ paśyenna 1vāsyā[1va] garbhastiṣṭhatīti vidyādajāta 1sārā[1nā] hi tadā garbhavatyo bhavanti| 1yasyāstu[1tasyāstu] khalu 1yoniḥ[1yoni] jātasāre puṣpam 1āsravati[1āśraya] tasyāḥ patati 1vāpyatikālaṃ[1vāpitya-] vā 'vatiṣṭhate gabhaḥ pariśuṣkagātra iti|| 4.8.6| caturthe khalu māse prativihite kṣīre navanītaṃ prāśnīyāt| pañcame kṣīrayavāgūḥ, ṣaṣṭhe kṣīrasarpiḥ, saptame dadhyudaśvit, aṣṭame kṣīrasarpiḥ, navame tu khalu māse prativihite 1madhurauṣadhasiddhena[1kadambamāṣṭerāghataitānuvāsa] tailenānuvāsaḥ|| 4.8.7| evaṃ hyasyāḥ 1pratimāsaṃ[1pratisaṃvartamānāyā yacchatanmataṃ] vartamānāyāḥ kukṣīkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭhaṃ mṛdūbhavati jīrṇapurīṣaṃ cādhaḥ travetsukhaṃ ca prajāyate|| 4.8.8| saptame tu khalu māse garbhaprapīḍitā 1vātapittaśleṣmāṇa[1-śleṣmāṇo] uraḥ prāpya 1savidāhaṃ[1vidahyamānāḥ] kaṇḍūṃ janayanti|tena kikkisāni jāyante strīṇām| triphalācūrṇaṃ śaśarudhireṇa piṣṭvā tenāsyāḥ tānyālepayet||4.8.9| aṣṭame tu khalu māse prativihite sati sūkikāgāraṃ samyak prāgdvāramudakdvāraṃ vā kārayet tinduka-1palāśa[1phalāśa]-aśvatthaiḥ||4.8.10| athātra pūrvasaṃkalpitāḥ syuḥ dvau khalu bilvamayau paryaṅkau śūrpau ca dvau taṇḍulamusalau gaṇḍopadhānaṃ 1yavāgūḥ[1mayau] sarpiśca tailaṃ ca sarṣapāśceti|| 4.8.11| athaināṃ prajanayiṣyatīti yavāgūṃ pāyayet| anāgatagarbhavedanāṃ caināmavahananaṃ ca kārayet| sā yadi jānīyādavabhraṣṭo me kukṣiḥ pravimukto me hṛdgarbhaḥ prasrutā me yoniriti, athaināmupakārikalpitanakhāścatasra 1upajīvikāḥ[1upajīvā] pratidinamupatiṣṭheyuḥ| śanaiḥ pūrvaṃ 1pravāhetapaścād[1pravāhetatpaścād] balavattaramiti|na cāpyanāgatavegā vā 1bāliśatayā[1bābāhūhli(?)tatayādyā], anāgatavegā hi 1duḥkhāyātmānaṃ[1tanā duḥkhā] prayacchati saha putreṇa|| 4.8.12| tasyāścet 1prajātāyā[1prajātāyāparānapra] aparā na prapadyate, tadaināṃ raktaśālīnāmakṣamātraṃ 1kalkamamlena[1kalpya] 1mūtreṇa[1mūtreṇa(?)] vā pāyayet| etenaiva kalpena dantīdravantīvṛścikālīvunarnavāvanaśīrṣākaṃ kārayet| 1tathā[1talau]-umākāla-1sarpa[1sarva]-purāṇamālānāmanyatamena dhūpayet| sā cedanena vidhinā na pravartate athaināṃ tīkṣṇaphala-1tailena[1taire]-anuvāsayet1||[1ayamadhyāyaḥ mātukāyāmardhe vicchinno dṛśyate|]
