||prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| ----------------------------------- ----------------------------------- 5.1.0|----------------dve vā jāta eva vinaśyati| 5.1.1| hrasvaikapakṣo vitato yastu garbhastu susvaraḥ| māsamekaṃ tu jīvitvā vināśāyopapadyate|| 5.1.2| piṇḍīśirā dīrghahanuranalpe saṃhate bhruvau| dvitīye māsi saṃprāpte mriyate garbha īdṛśaḥ|| 5.1.3| jātamātrasya garbhasya vyañjanaṃ yatra dṛśyate| tṛtīye māsi saṃprāpte mriyate garbha īdṛśaḥ|| 5.1.4| trikekaro ghaṭaśirā yastu garbhastu susvaraḥ| caturthe māsi saṃprāpte vināśamupagacchati|| 5.1.5| yasya ṣoḍaśavarśasya vyañjanaṃ tūpajāyate| śīghraṃ ca pañcadhātutvādalpāyuriha dṛśyate|| 5.1.6| yasya viṃśativarṣasya vyañjanaṃ tūpajāyate| sa dīrghamāyurāpnoti puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 5.1.7| śarīrāpacayo 'buddhirapathyāni balaṃ tathā| bālasya yasya dṛśyante taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet|| 5.1.8| yasya jātasya jāyete gulmakāstunakau tathā| aṣṭāviṃśe gate varṣe sarvaṃ taṃ hanti mānavam|| 5.1.9| 1pṛṣṭhe corasi 1cāvartaśavyatho yastu dṛśyate| catvāriṃśe gate varṣe maraṇāyopakalpate|| 5.1.10| 1āvarto yaśca pṛṣṭhe tu 1sannatastriṣu dṛśyate| phalamasya tu vijñeyaṃ sthāpanaṃ na prasūyate|| 5.1.11| sthūlāsthūlāṅgulī pāṇī nakhā 1yasyāpi lohitāḥ| 1kalyāṇadeśapratyaṅgaḥ pañcāśadvarṣa eva ca|| 5.1.12| vyūṭhorasko dīrghabhujaḥ sthūlajānuśca yo bhavet| dīrghāṅgulirdīrghanakhaḥ ṣaṣṭi varṣāṇi jīvati|| 5.1.13| utpīḍitasvaraṃ vāpi tuṅganāsakaconmukham| ūrukaṃ bhadrasampannaṃ 1vidyātsaptatikaṃ naraḥ|| 5.1.14| bhadraṃ 1puraśca paścācca ṛjukaṃ priyavādinam| aśītikaṃ naraṃ vidyātkṛṣṇātreyavaco yathā|| 5.1.15| lalāṭaṃ nāsikā karṇau yasyaitāni pṛthak pṛthak| ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇāni sa jīvati śataṃ samāḥ|| 5.1.16| yasyākuñcitameva syājjānubhyāṃ samitaṃ śiraḥ| ūrdhvajānugatau karṇau 1pautraṃ 1paśyatyayaṃ naraḥ|| 5.1.17| mahāntau vipulau karṇau bhavetāṃ romaśau tathā| snigdhau bahulakeśaśca sa ceha śatamṛcchati|| 5.1.18| dharmeṇa satyavākyena guruśuśrūṣaṇena ca| rasāyanopayogācca sa dīrghamanujīvati||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||
5.2.1| mukhaṃ netre śarīraṃ ca pāṇipādaṃ tathaiva ca| saraktaṃ dṛśyate yasya sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.2| yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ narāṇāṃ mūrdhni dṛśyate| śirasi 1snihyamāne ca kaṇḍūśaṃjāyate dṛḍham|| 5.2.3| yasya keśāḥ 1pramucyante śīrṇamūlāḥ śarīriṇaḥ| yasyaitāni tu rūpāṇi sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.4| nāsya dantāḥ 1prahṛṣyanti mukhaṃ ca na vilupyati| nābaddhaṃ 1bhāṣate cāpi sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.5| na vikṣipati gātrāṇi svaro 'sya na vivartate| vastreṇa gūhate guhyaṃ sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.6| na bhavatyunnato 1nābhiryathāvastho 'bhitiṣṭhati| sukhaṃ 1śvasiti rātrau ca sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.7| na nakhāḥ karkaśābhāsā na 1śyāvā na ca niṣprabhāḥ| prasannāśuprabhāścaiva sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati|| 5.2.8?| ātapādhiṣṭhito yastu na ... prakāśace| na ca lohitasaṃyu.......................... ..........................................
||tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|| ........................................................... ........................................................... ....dhitasvapne tāṃ rātriṃ nātivartate|| 5.3.1| iyaṃ me śiṣṭaśibikā vaiḍūryamaṇiyantritā| evaṃ pralāpayeccārto gatāyuriti taṃ viduḥ|| 5.3.2| prajvalatyapi yo dīpe tama evābhipaśyati| (1śabdānvipratibudhyeta cāpūrvāniva nāsti saḥ)|| 5.3.3| āvākśirāḥ pralambāmi nāma mā parivartaya| 1manujaḥ 1pralapannevaṃ saptāhaṃ nātivartate|| 5.3.4| 1marmāṇi dalitānīva yo 'bhīkṣṇaṃ cātisāryate| pravāhamāṇo durgandhi kuṇapaṃ pūtikaṃ tathā|| 5.3.5| tacca lohitagandhaṃ vāpyathavā matsyagandhikam| kṛṣṇaṃ nīlaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā mumūrṣuśca sa hocyate|| 5.3.6| madhumehī vasāmehī sarpirmehī ca yo naraḥ| bahumehī ca yo jantuḥ sa vai proktaḥ 1parāsukaḥ|| 5.3.7| prameheta yadā janturbinduṃ binduṃ savedanam| vāyunā bhinnavastiḥ syād durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.3.8| krimayo bahavo yasya niśaranti śarīriṇaḥ| āturasya śayānasya nauṣadhaṃ tasya sidhyati|| 5.3.9| ityetāni bhiṣak dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇāni mumūrṣatām| na cikitsāṃ prayuñjīta yathāmārgaṃ 1cikīrṣakaḥ||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|| 5.4.1| yadāturasya hṛdayaṃ vāyuḥ saṃgṛhya tiṣṭhati| 1dhamanīśaṃparīpīḍya sadyo jahyātsa jīvitam| 5.4.2| āturasya yadā vāyuḥ śarīramanupadyate| uttāne netraniṣyandaḥ sadyo jahyātsa jīvitam|| 5.4.3| yasya koṣṭhagato vāyurupāvṛttaśśarīriṇaḥ| kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya sadyo jahyātsa jīvitam|| 5.4.4| yasyāturasyeha vātādvātāṣṭhīlā vivardhate| na saṃsarati cānyatra sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ|| 5.4.5| yasyobhe piṇḍike stabdhe nāsā jihmā ca lakṣyate| vyāvṛtte cākṣiṇī yasya sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ|| 5.4.6| āmāśayasamutthānā yasyaiva parikartikā| tṛṣṇā ca tīvrarāgaśca sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ|| 5.4.7| pakvāśayasamutthānā yasya syātparikartikā| tṛṣṇā 1galagrahaścograḥ sadyo jahyātsa jīvitam|| 5.4.8| śoṇitaṃ romakūpebhyo yasya 1kṣarati dehinaḥ| atīva mukhato bhedi sadyo jahyātsa jīvitam|| 5.4.9| hṛdayasya tu saṃghātaṃ parikṣīṇasya dehinaḥ| atyarthaṃ 1pīḍayecchūlaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ|| 5.4.10| yasya kṣīṇaśarīrasya saṃjñāṃ harati mārutaḥ| vyāhanti ca mahāsrotaḥ sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ|| 5.4.11| hṛdayasya tu saṃghātaṃ parikṣīṇasya dehinaḥ| etairevaṃvidhairliṅgairanyaiścāpi tathāvidhaiḥ|| 1prakṛtervikṛtiṃ prāptaṃ parīkṣetāturaṃ bhiṣak|
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto yasyaśyāvīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.5.1| yasya śyāve ume netre dṛśyete harite tathā| utpannaśca śirorogaḥ phalitaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.2| 1haritāśca sirā yasya romakūpāśca lohitāḥ| 1bhuṅkte vānnāni sāmlāni tatraiva sa vinaśyati|| 5.5.3| yasyordhvavātaḥ kopena jantorāmāśayaṃ gataḥ| hṛdayaṃ parigṛhṇāti paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.4| gātre ca pāṇipāde ca yasya śuṣyati śoṇitam| muhurmuhurnṛtyati ca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.5| vṛṣaṇau pāṇipādau ca yasya śuṣkaṃ mukhaṃ tathā| chaviśca śoṣamāyāti paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.6| hanū hastau ca pādau ca 1vṛṣaṇau liṅgameva ca| dṛśyate dehino yasya paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.7| hṛdayaṃ dahyate 1yasya mumūrṣuṃ taṃ samādiśet| āturastu sa yāto vai paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.8| apasmāraḥ kṣayaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ raktapittamathodaram| gulmaśca madhumehaśca dīrgharogā bhavanti te|| 5.5.9| balamāṃsakṣayo yasya dehino dīrgharogiṇaḥ| dṛśyeta svarahāniśca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.10| hṛdayaṃ dahyate yasya koṣṭhe śūlaṃ svarakṣayaḥ| abhīkṣṇaṃ dahyate cāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.11| 1trāsābhitāpā jantūnāṃ koṣṭhe śūlāścaranti ca| hikkācchardiparītaśca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.12| 1vāpitaṃ jvalitaṃ martyaḥ, salilaṃ hi hutāśanam| bhāskaraṃ manyate somaṃ durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.13| yaścāpi vimale sūrye meghān paśyati sarvaśaḥ| durdinaṃ sudinaṃ cāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.5.14| yaṃ rasā nāvatiṣṭhante bheṣajaṃ cendriyāṇi tu| yasya vā viparītāni na ca jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.5.15| vānaspatyaphalaṃ mūlaṃ 1rogaspṛṣṭasya 1yasya vai| bhaiṣajyārthaṃ na dṛśyeta na ca jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.5.16| ityetāni bhiṣag dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇāni mumūrṣatām| 1na cikitsāṃ prayuñjīta 1yaśomārgapratīkṣayā|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ pūrvarūpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.6.1| 1antarlohitakāyastu bahiḥ pāṇḍuḥ prakāśate| pūrvarūpaṃ tadācaṣṭe mānavasya mumūrṣataḥ|| 5.6.2| bahirlohitakāyastu pāṇḍurantaḥ prakāśate| pūrvarūpamanuprāptaḥ sa mṛtyorucyate naraḥ|| 5.6.3| antarglāno bahiḥ pīno bahirādhmāta eva ca| 1yaścātyantasamādhmātaḥ sarve 'pyete parāsukāḥ|| 5.6.4| abhīkṣṇaṃ jvaryate yastu nivātamabhinandati| anuṣaktapratiśyāyaḥ kṣipraṃ śvāsena hanyate|| 5.6.5| 1ninādī vā pralāpī vā hasatyatyarthameva ca| unmādena kṛśo jantuḥ pañcatvamupagacchati|| 5.6.6| ghanaṃ saśūlaṃ yo veda sadāhaṃ hṛdayaṃ naraḥ| hṛdrogeṇa kṛśo janturvināśamupagacchati|| 5.6.7| prasvidyate ca 1kaṇḍūmān yo viruddhaṃ ca sevate| avirecanaśīlaśca kuṣṭhena 1sa vinaśyati|| 5.6.8| sukumāraśca yo jantuḥ snehaṃ māṃsaṃ ca sevate| divā svapiti cābhīkṣṇaṃ sa pramehī vinaśyati|| 5.6.9| pariśūnaśca yo jantuḥ svede ca paruṣacchaviḥ| bhinnaṃ yaścopaviśati so 'tisāreṇa hanyate|| 5.6.10| yasyāgniśca balaṃ caiva nālpaṃ bhavati dehinaḥ| kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.6.11| sadyo raktaṃ śiro yasya pītakaṃ vā pradṛśyate| kapilaṃ pluṣṭakeśaṃ vā yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.6.12| yasya netre 1lalāṭaṃ ca mukhaṃ 1nāsāṃ bhruvau tathā| jihmāni kurute vāyuryathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.6.13| śyāvā kaṇṭakinī jihvā yasya śuṣkā pradṛśyate| śyāve netre nakhāścāpi yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.6.14| yasya nirbhidyate kaṇṭhaḥ tāmyatyuccaiśśarīriṇaḥ| bahirāyāmabhājastaṃ pratyācakṣīta paṇḍitaḥ|| 5.6.15| yasyordhvakāye balavān navo rogastu 1duṣkriyaḥ| pūrvarūpaṃ tathā vācyaṃ mānavasya mariṣyataḥ|| 5.6.16| yasya cucchundarīgandhaḥ puruṣasya bhavatyatha| sauvarṇānapi vṛkṣāṃśca yo veda sa vinaśyati|| 5.6.17| ityebhirīdṛśaiścānyairvikārairvarṇitaṃ naraḥ| nopakrameta medhāvī ya icchedātmanaḥ sukham|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||
||saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāta indriyāṇīkamindriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.7.1| indriyāṇi yathā jantoḥ parīkṣeta viśeṣataḥ| āyuḥpramāṇaṃ 1jijñāsurbhiṣak tanme nibodhata|| 5.7.2| annapānātparīkṣeta darśanādyaiśca tattvataḥ| arthādivihitaṃ jñānamindriyāṇāmatīndriyam|| 5.7.3| svasthebhyo vikṛtaṃ yasya jñānamindriyasaṃśrayam| alakṣitaṃ nimittena lakṣaṇaṃ 1maraṇe hi tat|| 5.7.4| ityuktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ 1samyagindriyeṣvaśubhodayam| tadeva 1tu punarbhūyo vistareṇa nibodha me|| 5.7.5| ghanībhūtamivākāśaṃ 1paśyaṃstamiva 1medinīm| 1vigītaṃ hyubhayaṃ hyetatpaśyanmaraṇamṛcchati|| 5.7.6| yasya darśanamāyāti māruto 'mbaragocaraḥ| 1agnirnāyāti vā 1dīptaḥ tasyāpi kṣayamādiśet|| 5.7.7| jale 'pi nirmale jālamajālaṃ manute naraḥ| 1sthire gacchati vā dṛṣṭvā jīvitātparihīyate|| 5.7.8| jāgratpaśyati yaḥ pretān rakṣāṃsi vividhāni ca| anyadvāpyadbhutaṃ kiṃcinna sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.7.9| yo 'gniṃ prakṛtivarṇasthaṃ nīlaṃ paśyati niṣprabham| kṛṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā śuklaṃ na sa jīvati mānavaḥ|| 5.7.10| 1marīcīnasato meghe 1meghānvāpyamalāmbare| vidyuto vā vinā meghānna sa jīvati mānavaḥ|| 5.7.11| mṛṇmayīmiva 1vā pātrīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vāpi purīṣitām| ādityamardhacandraṃ vā kṣipraṃ dṛṣṭvā vinaśyati|| 5.7.12| naktaṃ sūryamahaścandramavahnau dhūmamutthitam| agniṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rātrau, maraṇamādiśet|| 5.7.13| prabhāvataḥ prabhāṃ hīnāṃ 1niṣprabhānvā prabhāvataḥ| narān viliṅgān paśyanti 1bhāvān bhāvajighāṃsavaḥ|| 5.7.14| vyākṛtīni ca varṇāni visaṃkhyopacitāni ca| nimittāni ca paśyanti rūpāṇyāyuḥparikṣayāt|| 5.7.15| 1yastu paśyatyadṛśyaṃ vā dṛśyaṃ yastu na paśyati| tāvubhau gacchataḥ kṣipraṃ yamakṣayamasaṃśayam|| 5.7.16| aśabdasya ca yaḥ 1śrotā śabdaṃ 1yaśca na vindati| dvāvapyetau yathā pretau tathā jñeyau vijānatā|| 5.7.17| viparyayeṇa yo vidyād gandhānāṃ caiva nāma tam| na vā tatsarvato vidyādvidyāttaṃ vai gatāyuṣam|| 5.7.18| yo rasaṃ na vijānāti 1vipakvaṃ vā ca tattvataḥ| 1apakvaṃ dṛśyate, 1pakvaṃ tamāhuḥ kuśalā narāḥ|| 5.7.19| uṣṇān śītān kharān 1ślakṣṇān mṛdūnapi ca dāruṇān| 1spṛśyān spṛṣṭvā tato 'nyacca mumūrṣusteṣu manyate|| 5.7.20| antareṇa tapastīvraṃ yogaṃ vā vidhipūrvakam| indriyairadhikaṃ paśyan pañcatvamupapadyate|| 5.7.21| indriyāṇāmṛte 1dṛṣṭerindriyārthānnadoṣajān| naraḥ paśyati yaḥ kaścidindriyairna sa jīvati|| 5.7.22| svasthāḥ 1prajñāviparyāsairindriyārtheṣu vaikṛtam| paśyanti ye tu bahuśaḥ teṣāṃ maraṇamādiśet|| 5.7.23| etadeva ca vijñānaṃ yaśamyaganupaśyati| maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ caiva sa bhiṣag jñātumarhati||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto dūtādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.8.1| tṛṇānnakhānvā chindan vai bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.2| viplutaṃ bhāṣamāṇaśca bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.3| bhinatti kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena loṣṭaṃ loṣṭhena vāpyadhaḥ| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.4| spṛśannaṅgāni bālāṃśca bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.5| 1pidhāya pāṇinā nābhiṃ bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.6| kapālikāṃ śarkarāṃ vā bhinattyaṅgārikāmapi| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.7| āste bhūmau pariśrānto gṛhṇātyaṅgamatha bhraman| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.8| naṣṭaṃ mṛtamatikrāntaṃ nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ| ityāturasya hi yadā 1vadeddūto na so 'sti vai|| 5.8.9| karaṃ kareṇa gṛhṇāti pāṇinā tāḍayetkaram| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.10| khādedoṣṭhau ca jihvāṃ ca nakhān dantaiśca kalpayet| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.11| āturasya yadā gehe 1vaidye vai paryupasthite| chidyate bhidyate caiva pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.12| 1parāvartya ghaṭaṃ pūrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paripṛcchati| āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyastathāvidhaḥ|| 5.8.13| gṛdhraḥ sṛgālaḥ kākaścāpyulūko vāyasastathā| nadeyurdakṣiṇe pārśve rogiṇo yasya nāsti saḥ|| 5.8.14| kaṣāyavastro muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vātha 1nagnakaḥ| carmabhirvā parivṛto, mahānasyeva śāṭikaḥ|| 5.8.15| tailābhyaktaśchinnanāso vāgmī conmatta eva vā| bhagnauṣṭhaḥ kharavāṭo vā na dūtaḥ sampraśasyate|| 5.8.16| iti dūtasamācāro vyādhitānāṃ 1prakīrtitaḥ| 1ya evaṃ veda nipuṇaṃ siddhikāmaḥ 1sa vai bhiṣak||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto gomayacūrṇaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.9.1| cūrṇaṃ śirasi yasyaiva śuṣkagomayasannibham| snehino dṛśyate jantormāsāddehaṃ jahāti saḥ|| 5.9.2| kṛśasya kapharogeṇa yasya śleṣmaparikṣayaḥ| karṇau raktau mukhaṃ 1caiva dvau māsau nātivartate|| 5.9.3| yasya lohitakābhāsamambu tāluni dṛśyate| kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya sa māsaṃ nātivartate|| 5.9.4| arundhatīṃ na paśyettu sthitāṃ saptarṣisaṃsadi| sa māsādaṣṭamānmartyaḥ kṣipraṃ prāṇairvimucyate|| 5.9.5| 1aṇukābhiśca kṛṣṇābhirāsyaṃ jihvā ca tāluke| sarvataśamanucchinnaṃ na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.6| śīrṣābhitāpino yasya 1śleṣmarogavatastathā| hikkā viniṣyandate vai nāyamastīti nirdiśet|| 5.9.7| yasya lomāni keśāśca pluṣyantīva śarīriṇaḥ| 1saṃhṛṣṭānīva vā dehī na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.8| yasya kālāntare dantā dṛśyante raktasannibhāḥ| niṣprabhāścānuliptā vā na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.9| kṣāreṇa vidhṛtaṃ gātraṃ dṛśyate yasya dehinaḥ| samamuṣṇe ca śīte ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.10| gātreṣu 1kharavarṇeṣu yasya vārilavaplavaḥ| anabhyakteṣu gātreṣu na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.11| śūlamaṅge bhavedyasya sphuṭitaṃ raktamāsravet| adho golakasaṃkāśaṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.9.12| āpāṇḍu 1madhumehe tu yaśca mehati mānavaḥ| abhyantareṇa 1pañcāhātsa pañcatvaṃ 1hi gacchati|| 5.9.13| aratiścāvipākaśca kārśyadaurbalyameva ca| yasya saṃdṛśyate jantorna sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.9.14| yastu dīnamanātho vā balena parihīyate| bhidyāmārogamāpnoti yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.9.15| 1anuvṛttau yathā jantuḥ pittena parimūrcchitaḥ| saṃmūḍhavākyo bhavati yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.9.16| yastvāsane 'tha śayane ratiṃ na labhate naraḥ| sa śīghraṃ kurute kālaṃ yaśca sāśrūṇi khādati|| 5.9.17| āruhya vānaraṃ yastu saṃkalpaṃ nāvabudhyate| tamāhuḥ paralokāya 1svapne tu kuśalā narāḥ|| 5.9.18| parisaṃvatsarādyasya jvaro nāpaiti dehinaḥ| uṣṇo vā yadi vā śīto yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.9.19| yasya jātapramehasya piṭakā pāṇḍurā bhavet| sopadravā śatapadā yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.9.20| yasyordhvaṃ 1kramate vāyuḥ śrotraṃ vādhaḥ pravartate| sarvāṇi ca prabhidyante yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.9.21| ityetairlakṣaṇairyuktaṃ bhiṣak dṛṣṭvaiva mānavam| nopakramettathā vīra rakṣannātmayaśaḥ sphuṭam||
ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaśchāyādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.10.1| anucchāyāthavā jantordṛḍhacchāyāthavā punaḥ| vicchinnā yasya vā chāyā na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.10.2| yo vidyutamivākāśe vyabhre paśyati mānavaḥ| dhūmāyate śiraśchāyā yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ|| 5.10.3| lākṣāraktaṃ yathā vastramevaṃ paśyati yo mahīm| athavā raktamākāśaṃ raktapittena hanyate|| 5.10.4| yo hṛṣṭaromā puruṣaḥ kāsena śleṣmaṇācitaḥ| 1kaṇṭhaśca śūkānugato yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ|| 5.10.5| yasya śaṅkhāccyutaṃ māṃsaṃ śyāve netre tathaiva ca| cūrṇakaśca mukhe jātaḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.10.6| yasya hastāccyutaṃ māṃsaṃ jantordṛśyeta kuṣṭhinaḥ| athāviprayuktasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ|| 5.10.7| avipakvaṃ vipakvaṃ vā bhuktaṃ bhuktaṃ yathā bhavet| kāśaśvāsajvaraiḥ spṛṣṭo nāsti tasya cikitsitam|| 5.10.8| hṛdayaṃ 1pūrvamāvāti yasya snātasya dehinaḥ| ardhamāsātparaṃ tasya jīvitaṃ nātivartate|| 5.10.9| ūrdhvaśvāsahato yastu raktaṃ pracchardayennaraḥ| śūlaṃ vā bhinnakoṣṭhasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ|| 5.10.10| 1antardāho 'dhiko yasya śītārtiścāpi bāhyataḥ| ākāśaṃ paripūrṇaṃ vā vetti yo na sa jīvati|| 5.10.11| yasya pakvāvubhāvoṣṭhau nīlau 1jambūphalopamau| ucchūnaṃ yasya ca śiraḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.10.12| yasyocchūnaṃ bhavenmadhyamubhāvaṃsau kṛśau tathā| viriktaḥ punarādhmāti yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.10.13| etadindriyavijñānaṃ yaśamyaganupaśyati| sa 1jīvitaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyādbhiṣagvaraḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||ekadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athātaḥ puṣpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.11.1| śirasyaṅge raktavarṇaṃ yo 'nilaṃ vāpi paśyati| ghaṭikāmekavarṇaṃ vā sa puṣpita ihocyate|| 5.11.2| aṣṭāpadaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ jagatīṃ yaḥ prapaśyati| sa dṛṣṭiparihīnatvātpuṣpitaḥ procyate naraḥ|| 5.11.3| suptaśca saṃvṛte gehe paśyatyākāśameva yaḥ| romanthayati dantaiśca sa puṣpita ihocyate|| 5.11.4| dīpyamānamivākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca vanāni ca| yo vetti 1romasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate|| 5.11.5| anullipto yathā dehī vāti 1cetkuṇapaṃ yathā| sevante makṣikāścaiva puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate|| 5.11.6| avijñātā naraṃ nārī svapna 1eva nivāsinī| dakṣiṇāṃ diśamehīti yaṃ brūyānna sa jīvati|| 5.11.7| prakīrṇakeśo vikaraḥ svapne yo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam| 1pratipadyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.8| kuśairiva nirūḍhāṅgamātmānaṃ svapna īkṣate| khaṃ vā sadhūmaṃ yo vetti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.9| yaḥ svapne vṛkṣamāruhya na rogī trāyate gṛhe| prakīrṇakeśo vikacaḥ 1yo 'gnimāruhya roditi|| 5.11.10| prāsādamekasthūṇaṃ tu svapne yaścādhirohati| naro nṛtyati paṅke vā 1sa pumānna ca jīvati|| 5.11.11| svapne prāsādamāruhya mahāntaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā| yo 1nṛttagītapānānnī na sa jīvati mānavaḥ|| 5.11.12| gajenoṣṭreṇa vā gacchan yaḥ paśyeddakṣiṇāṃ diśam| jīvettu rogī saptāhaṃ, nīrogaḥ śaradāṃ śatam|| 5.11.13| yāti yo durdine vāpi svapne vā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam| pratibudhyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.14| bhāsairbarhivarāhaiśca śvabhirmahiṣavājibhiḥ| samaṃ yo taddivā yone svapne yogaphalaṃ bhavet|| 5.11.15| yadā gaṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca svapne cāśnaṃśca paśyati| prakīrṇakeśamapi ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.16| yaḥ svapne puruṣaḥ kālaṃ pītaṃ vā vastramṛcchati| gāyannaceṣṭayanvāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.17| yaḥ svapne 1vītakāmo 'pi pītāṃ pibati vāruṇīm| citrakaṇṭhaguṇo vāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.11.18| 1ākulāpāṃ nadīṃ svapne yovagāheta mānavaḥ| jīvetsarogaśaptāhaṃ, nīrogasśaradāṃ śatam|| 5.11.19| svapne snātānuliptasya bhraṃśedyasya tu 1varṇakaḥ| gātrasya puruṣasyeha 1sa śastreṇa vinaśyati|| 5.11.20| etadindriyavijñānaṃ yaśamyaganupaśyati| 1jīvitaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| ityāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| iti bhele indriye ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||
||dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāto+1avākcitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 5.12.1| avākcitā vā jihmā vā yasya chāyālpikā bhāvet| netre ca viṣame syātāṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.2| yadi dīnāni pakṣmāṇi na nimīlanti dehinaḥ| dahyete nayane vāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.3| 1namantyau yasya dṛśyete 1bhruvau mūrdhani bā 1sthite| jīvettu sa 1tryahaṃ rogī ṣaṇmāsān vyādhivarjitaḥ|| 5.12.4| 1luñcyamāneṣu keśeṣu 1vedayannāti vedanām| 1nivṛttasukha1duḥkhaḥ syātparetaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.5| yasyāturasya piṭakā vyaṅgo vā dṛśyate mukhe| adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ prathamaṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.6| śuṣyate nāsikāvaṃśaḥ pṛthutvaṃ yasya gacchati| 1aṃso 'nilāt kāsavataḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.7| atyuṣṇaṃ vātiśītaṃ vā stabdhaṃ vā mṛdu vāpyatha| manyate pāṇipādaṃ ca paretaṃ tasya jībitam|| 5.12.8| yo 'vatīrya nadīṃ pūrṇāṃ toye paśyati jālakam| gātraṃ liptamathādbhiśca yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ|| 5.12.9| vivartayati yaḥ śīrṣamatyarthaṃ ca 1nasā naraḥ| na svidyate lalāṭaṃ ca nāsti tasya cikitsitam|| 5.12.10| jvaryate kāsate vāpi tathocchavasiti vai dṛḍham| ākramyate tāmyate ca yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.12.11| yasyodaraṃ 1samādhmātaṃ tadvartma ca vibhāvyate| bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| 5.12.12| 1anārataṃ gṛhe yasya 1kāṃsyaṃ bhidyeta dehinaḥ| candrastīkṣṇo mṛduścārko yasya syāttaṃ vivarjayet|| 5.12.13| apradhātuḥ pradhāturvā svastho vā yadi 1vā++āturaḥ| yaścandanamivāvāti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ|| 5.12.14| yūthikotpannagaṇḍaśca, vāti yaścāpi vartmavat| abhaktaḥ tasimaṃ bālye yo vāti na sa jīvati|| 5.12.15| dviṣadbhiḥ kurute sakhyaṃ yaḥ priyairyāti vipriyam| akasmātkupyate yastu paretaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 5.12.16| 1ebhirevaṃvidhairliṅgairanyaiścāpi yathāyatham| nopakrameta medhāvī bhiṣaganvitamāturam|| 5.12.17| etadbhiṣagariṣṭānāṃ yo jñānamanubudhyate| yathoktaṃ veda vedāyuḥ sa bhiṣak śāstrakovidaḥ||

||cikitsāsthānam|| ||prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| athāta ekādaśasarpiṣkaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ| 6.1.1| akalpayanna yajñāṅgaṃ purā dakṣastriśūline| tasmātpraṇāśayāmāsa yajñaṃ dakṣasya śaṅkaraḥ|| 6.1.2| taṃ ca nāśayatā yajñaṃ devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā| krodhenoṣṇaṃ viniśvasya tān lokān vyāpito jvaraḥ|| 6.1.3| sa eṣa santāpayati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam| nidhane cāpi bhūtānāṃ nānyo tasmājjvara iti smṛtiḥ|| 6.1.6| śārīramānasānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ 1pravaro jvaraḥ| tasmātprathamatastasya pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam|| 6.1.7| uktarūpasamutthānā jvarāścāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ| śītaścoṣṇaśca niyataḥ samāsāt 1dvividho jvaraḥ|| 6.1.8| śītasyoṣṇāṃ kriyāṃ kuryādvātaśleṣmātmakasya1 tu| uṣṇasyaikāntapittasya śītāṃ kuryātkriyāṃ bhiṣak|| 6.1.9| vāyurāmāśayātpūrvamūṣmāṇaṃ samudīrayet1| tvaggato roma cāpannaḥ saṃharṣayati mānavam|| 6.1.10| sa tu pittānubandhena tejasā paripācitaḥ| prāpnoti vilayaṃ śleṣmā sambandheneva toyadaḥ|| 6.1.11| 1śānte śīte punardāhaṃ pittātprāpnoti mānavaḥ| buddhimatāṃ proktaṃ samāsena cikitsitam|| 6.1.14| durlabhā buddhimantastu tasmādvakṣyāmi vistaram| ekādaśaprakāraṃ hi 1jvaritānāṃ cikitsitam|| 6.1.15| sarpiścaikādaśaṃ vidyāt tanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu| 1siddhāśvedāḥ kaṣāyāśca lehaḥ pācanakāni ca|| 6.1.16| cūrṇaḥ pradehāśekāśca vaṭikā modakāḥ payaḥ| sarpiścaikādaśaṃ proktaṃ siddhamāmamathāpi ca|| 6.1.17| eṣāṃ prayogaṃ vakṣyāmi vīryāṇi ca pṛthak vāyuśca śāmyataḥ| 1tayoścāpyanulomatvātpittam 1apyupaśāmyati|| 6.1.22| tasmāduṣṇodakaṃ peyaṃ śreṣṭhamāhurnavajvare|| 6.1.23| śītaṃ hi salilaṃ pītaṃ kopayetkaphamārutau| kuryād bhūyo 'gnimṛdutāṃ nīvārāśapramodakāḥ| yavānnavikṛtiścāpi bhojaneṣu hitāśadā|| 6.1.30| kapiñjalāśahariṇā vartakāḥ kālapucchakāḥ| eṇā 1vartīrakāścaiva jāṅgalā jvarite hitāḥ|| 6.1.31| mudgāḍhakīmasūrāṇāṃ 1satīnānāṃ śoṣayatyeṣa bhūtāni dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ| tasmācchoṣopacāreṇa kuryāttasya cikitsitam|| 6.2.11| triphalākvāthasiddhena ghṛtena matimān bhiṣak| snehayettaṃ yathānyāyaṃ yuktyā 1vṛṣaghṛtena vā|| 6.2.12| 1paritapyate|| 6.19.3| bhinnavarṇo 'tha dīnaśca hṛdi kaṇḍūśca jāyate| hṛdrogaḥ krimijaḥ proktaḥ pañcamaśa tu durjayaḥ|| 6.19.4| sādhyāstrayastu hṛdrogā vātapittakaphātmakāḥ| 1dvau cāsādhyau smṛtau puṣkaramūlaṃ ca cūrṇaṃ hṛdroganāśanam|| 6.19.7| pāṭhāvacāyavakṣārā 1abhayā cāmlavetasam| durālabhā citrakaṃ ca tryūṣaṇaṃ lavaṇatrayam|| 6.19.8| śaṭhī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca tintriṇīkaṃ sadāḍimam| mātuluṅgyāśca bījāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet|| 6.19.9| sukhodakena madyairvā cūrṇānyetāni pāyayet| arśaḥ śūlaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ gulmaṃ cāpi vyapohati|| 6.19.10| sauvarcalaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ dāḍimaṃ sāmlavetasam| śvāsahṛdrogaśamanamidaṃ syāddhiṅgupañcamam1|| 6.19.11| 1pañcāśadabhayākalkaṃ pale sauvarcalasya ca| caturguṇajale mukhyaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet|| 6.19.12| etadvallabhakaṃ nāma prāṇināṃ sarpiruttamam| amṛtapratimaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ śvāsahṛdroganāśanam|| 6.19.13| pibetkalyāṇakaṃ sarpirdhānvantaramathāpi vā| mātuluṅgasya ca 1rasaṃ 1pibetkṣārāgadānapi|| 6.19.14| śatapākaṃ balātailaṃ śairīṣaṃ sukumārakam| tailānyetāni seveta sadā hṛdgadapīḍitaḥ|| 6.19.15| pibedrasāyanaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrāṇi ca guḍānapi| pittahṛdrogaśamanā ye coktā ghṛtamodakāḥ|| 6.19.16| jīvakarṣabhakau drākṣā śarkarā śreyasī balā| dve mede dve ca kākolyau 1kharjūryasitamutpalam|| 6.19.17| ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacedebhiḥ tulyāṃśairmāhiṣaṃ bhiṣak| caturguṇena payasā pātavyaṃ yuktitaśca tat|| 6.19.18| vātapittasamutthāne hṛdroge nāśanaṃ param| vasā lābhena majjā ca tulyaṃ tailaghṛtaṃ tathā|| 6.19.19| amūni lābhato dadyādatha cāpi caturguṇam| vacā trikaṭukaṃ rāsnā jīvantī jīvako balā|| 6.19.20| nidigdhikā cāṃśumatī nīlī bhārṅgīṃ punarnavā| siddhamebhirmahāsnehaṃ balamālokya pāyayet|| 6.19.21| hṛdrogaṃ vātikaṃ snehaḥ sadya eva cikitsati| vicārayetsvayaṃ buddhyā vaidyo hṛdrogabheṣajam|| 6.19.22| madhuraṃ pittahṛdroge snigdhamuṣṇaṃ ca vātike| trayastu pariśeṣā ye tīkṣṇoṣṇaistānupācaret|| 6.19.23| kṣāraiḥ kṣārāgadaiścaiva vamanaiśavirecanaiḥ| cikitsitaṃ vistareṇa yaduktaṃ kṛmikoṣṭhinām|| 6.19.24| tadeva1
